027c48446860eb35.zh: 「-ㄴ 터라」為固定句型，表示「由於…的情況」，故選「터라」。
027c48446860eb35.en: The fixed construction -(으)ㄴ 터라 provides the background circumstance as a reason.

027c48446860eb35.zh: 「터에서」是名詞加場所格助詞，此處非表場所，不能成句。
027c48446860eb35.en: The form 터에서 treats 터 as a physical site with 에서, which does not form the causal grammar pattern.

027c48446860eb35.zh: 「터로」不是表示「情況為原因」的慣用連接句型。
027c48446860eb35.en: The form 터로 uses the particle 로, which does not fit this grammatical construction.

027c48446860eb35.zh: 「터를」是受格助詞，無法在此連接句子說明滑倒的理由。
027c48446860eb35.en: The form 터를 adds an object particle, which cannot connect the clause to explain the reason.

02cf664d67ba5b17.zh: 時間副詞「요즘은」接原因「바빠서」，再接慣用語「숨 쉴」修飾「겨를도 없어요」。
02cf664d67ba5b17.en: 요즘은 sets the topic, 바빠서 gives the reason, and 숨 쉴 naturally modifies 겨를도 없어요.

03298a879e339dcf.zh: 「이 길을」作賓語接動詞「걷노라면」，冠形詞「작은」修飾後文「마을」。
03298a879e339dcf.en: 이 길을 is the object of 걷노라면, and 작은 modifies the following noun 마을.

0361432c89f8e0a3.zh: 「-ㄴ 터라」表示情況作為後項的理由或背景，符合語意。
0361432c89f8e0a3.en: The pattern -(으)ㄴ 터라 indicates the background situation as the reason for what follows.

0361432c89f8e0a3.zh: 「대로」表示按照或一…就…，無法與「-ㄴ」搭配表示原因。
0361432c89f8e0a3.en: The pattern 대로 means according to or as soon as, which does not express circumstances or reasons here.

0361432c89f8e0a3.zh: 「김에」表示「順便」，語意與前句筋疲力盡的背景不合。
0361432c89f8e0a3.en: The phrase -(으)ㄴ 김에 means while one is at it or taking the opportunity, which does not fit.

0361432c89f8e0a3.zh: 「줄」常接「알다/모르다」表示知不知道，文法與語意皆不符。
0361432c89f8e0a3.en: The dependent noun 줄 is used with 알다/모르다 to express knowing whether or how, which does not fit.

04d2df4572ed8291.zh: 副詞 아무리 修飾形容詞 바쁘다손，接續 치더라도 構成讓步，後接賓語 전화。
04d2df4572ed8291.en: The adverb 아무리 modifies 바쁘다손 치더라도, followed by the object 전화 before the verb.

0505c426c1ea45ed.zh: 「조금이나마」表示「哪怕只是一點點」，常接希望有幫助的積極客氣表達。
0505c426c1ea45ed.en: 조금이나마 (even a little) pairs naturally with the polite hope 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.

0505c426c1ea45ed.zh: 「도움이 안 됐습니다」表示完全沒幫上忙，與委婉表達心意的語境相悖。
0505c426c1ea45ed.en: 도움이 안 됐습니다 means it was of no help, contradicting the polite supportive intent.

0505c426c1ea45ed.zh: 「방해가 됩니다」表示造成妨礙，與「조금이나마」表達的心意相悖。
0505c426c1ea45ed.en: 방해가 됩니다 means it causes a disturbance, which contradicts the intention of조금이나마.

0505c426c1ea45ed.zh: 「도움이 필요 없습니다」表示不需要幫助，語義在此不合邏輯。
0505c426c1ea45ed.en: 도움이 필요 없습니다 means no help is needed, which makes no sense here.

081d242bc1d82f91.zh: 慣用型「-고도 남다」用於此處表示「很有可能做出那種事、完全做得出來」。
081d242bc1d82f91.en: The idiom -고도 남다 means quite capable of doing something negative, here 거짓말을 하고도 남지.

081d242bc1d82f91.zh: 「하고 남지」漏掉了強調助詞「도」，不符合慣用型「-고도 남다」。
081d242bc1d82f91.en: 하고 남지 misses the particle 도, which is required in the set expression -고도 남다.

081d242bc1d82f91.zh: 「하고도 없지」在語意與慣用搭配上皆不成立，應使用表示充裕的 남다。
081d242bc1d82f91.en: 하고도 없지 is ungrammatical and meaningless in this context.

081d242bc1d82f91.zh: 「해도 많지」語法結構錯誤，無法表達某人完全有能力做出某事的語意。
081d242bc1d82f91.en: 해도 많지 is an incorrect construction and does not convey being capable of an action.

08f95b6311a6b65a.zh: 「就當作得到一次好經驗並再次挑戰」符合前述寬慰心態後的積極行為。
08f95b6311a6b65a.en: 다시 도전하겠습니다 (will try again) naturally follows consoling oneself that failure was a good experience.

08f95b6311a6b65a.zh: 「再次失敗了」與下定決心重新嘗試的文脈不符。
08f95b6311a6b65a.en: 다시 실패했습니다 (failed again) does not fit a resolution based on learning from failure.

08f95b6311a6b65a.zh: 「沒有經驗」與前半句「當作經歷了一次好經驗」前後矛盾。
08f95b6311a6b65a.en: 경험이 없습니다 (have no experience) contradicts treating the failure as experience.

08f95b6311a6b65a.zh: 「計算」誤將依存名詞「셈」當作動詞字面上的「計算、算帳」。
08f95b6311a6b65a.en: 셈을 하겠습니다 confuses the bound noun 셈 in this grammar with counting.

0a5f855983382ec4.zh: 接在「넘어질」後構成「-(으)ㄹ세라」，表示擔心孩子摔倒。
0a5f855983382ec4.en: Attaches to 넘어질 to complete -(으)ㄹ세라, expressing fear of the child falling.
-(으)ㄹ수록 means the more..., which does not fit the context.

0a5f855983382ec4.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 만큼」表示程度「到了……的地步」，語意不符。
0a5f855983382ec4.en: -(으)ㄹ 만큼 indicates extent or degree, which does not fit here.
-(으)ㄹ뿐더러 means not only... but also, making no sense here.

0af4d02d7eedd7be.zh: 「매진되었다（售罄）」最符合「-기 무섭게（一開始販售立刻……）」的快速後果。
0af4d02d7eedd7be.en: 매진되었다 describes the rapid outcome that immediately followed the start of ticket sales.

0af4d02d7eedd7be.zh: 「開始販售了」與前面的「開始販售」語義重複且矛盾。
0af4d02d7eedd7be.en: This repeats the same action as the first clause and creates nonsense.

0af4d02d7eedd7be.zh: 「還剩很多」與「-기 무섭게」所強調動作瞬間引發的劇烈轉折語意相反。
0af4d02d7eedd7be.en: This contradicts the dramatic immediacy implied by -기 무섭게 in ticket sales.

0af4d02d7eedd7be.zh: 「很貴」是描述價格狀態，並非一開始販售後立刻發生的事件。
0af4d02d7eedd7be.en: This is a static quality and cannot follow as an immediate action in this pattern.

0c8174802a748302.zh: 「-기(가) 무섭게」是固定文法句型，接在動詞詞幹後表示「一……就立刻……」。
0c8174802a748302.en: 기가 correctly forms the set grammar pattern -기(가) 무섭게, meaning no sooner than or the moment.

0c8174802a748302.zh: 「는 무섭게」非正確文法，該句型必須接名詞形字尾「-기(가)」。
0c8174802a748302.en: 는 무섭게 is ungrammatical; this pattern requires the nominalizer -기(가).

0c8174802a748302.zh: 「게 무섭게」非正確搭配，無法與「무섭게」構成「一……就立刻……」的句型。
0c8174802a748302.en: 게 무섭게 is not a valid grammatical construction here.

0c8174802a748302.zh: 「자」接詞幹表「一……就」，但不能與後方的「무섭게」疊加使用。
0c8174802a748302.en: 자 forms -자마자 alone and cannot directly precede 무섭게.

0c9d925952cab19e.zh: 「-ㄴ들」為反詰語氣，後句常用反問句「難道連一通電話都不能打嗎？」。
0c9d925952cab19e.en: After the rhetorical concession -ㄴ들, a rhetorical question like 전화 한 통 못 하겠어요? is natural.

0c9d925952cab19e.zh: 「전화를 했어요」為單純陳述過去打電話，失去反詰批評的語氣。
0c9d925952cab19e.en: 전화를 했어요 is a plain statement of past fact, lacking the rhetorical contrast.

0c9d925952cab19e.zh: 「전화할게요」表示未來承諾，與前面「不管多忙…」語氣不搭配。
0c9d925952cab19e.en: 전화할게요 states a future promise, which does not fit the rhetorical pattern.

0c9d925952cab19e.zh: 「전화하고 있어요」表示現在進行式，無法與反詰讓步句型呼應。
0c9d925952cab19e.en: 전화하고 있어요 indicates a continuous action, which does not match the prompt.

0d5d6e3334e35075.zh: 慣用句型「-고도 남다」表示「完全足以、綽綽有餘」，因此此處應填入「남아」。
0d5d6e3334e35075.en: The set phrase is -고도 남다, meaning more than enough to, so 남아 is correct here.

0d5d6e3334e35075.zh: 「많아」表示單純數量多，無法與前面的「-고도」搭配構成「綽綽有餘」的慣用表達。
0d5d6e3334e35075.en: 많아 means many or much, but it does not form the idiom -고도 남다.

0d5d6e3334e35075.zh: 「있어」表示存在，不能與 -고도 搭配表示「充分理解」的語意。
0d5d6e3334e35075.en: 있어 expresses existence and does not pair with -고도 in this emphatic idiom.

0d5d6e3334e35075.zh: 「돼」表示可以或成為，無法與「이해하고도」搭配形成表示程度充裕的慣用語。
0d5d6e3334e35075.en: 돼 means to become or be allowed, which does not fit the pattern with 이해하고도.

0f2917d63e3761b6.zh: 慣用語為「-기 그지없다」，過去式結尾接「그지없었다」表示極度悲傷。
0f2917d63e3761b6.en: The pattern is A-기 그지없다; past tense 그지없었다 correctly expresses boundless sadness.

0f2917d63e3761b6.zh: 此慣用句型固定搭配否定詞「없다」，不存在「그지있다」的用法。
0f2917d63e3761b6.en: The idiom is fixed with 없다; the form 그지있다 does not exist.

0f2917d63e3761b6.zh: 「그지없게 했다」為使動結構，語意變成使某人無比…，不符文意。
0f2917d63e3761b6.en: 그지없게 했다 is a causative structure meaning made someone extremely..., which does not fit.

0f2917d63e3761b6.zh: 「그지않았다」不是正確的韓語詞彙或慣用表達方式。
0f2917d63e3761b6.en: 그지않았다 is not a valid Korean word or grammatical form.

103c2fdbe6c34bb3.zh: 「-건만」接在過去式後表示雖然多次聯絡，卻不如預期地沒收到回覆。
103c2fdbe6c34bb3.en: 건만 expresses contrast with regret: despite having contacted multiple times, there was no reply.

103c2fdbe6c34bb3.zh: 「-거니와」表示並列同向事實，而後句「沒有回信」為逆向遺憾結果。
103c2fdbe6c34bb3.en: 거니와 adds facts in the same direction, but the lack of reply is an unexpected contrast.

103c2fdbe6c34bb3.zh: 「-거든」表示假定條件，無法陳述過去已發生且帶有轉折的事實。
103c2fdbe6c34bb3.en: 거든 expresses a condition, which cannot express this past factual contrast.

103c2fdbe6c34bb3.zh: 「-고자」表示做某事的目的，不能連接過去式詞尾「-었-」。
103c2fdbe6c34bb3.en: 고자 denotes intent and cannot attach to the past-tense suffix -었-.

120f2e564ecdc815.zh: 處所名詞「집에」接動詞短語「들어오기 무섭게」，後接間接引述的受詞「배고프다고」。
120f2e564ecdc815.en: 집에 modifies 들어오기 무섭게 (the moment he came home), which is followed by 배고프다고 for the speech predicate.

135d6040cdee56b2.zh: 「위험」有收音，搭配「을 무릅쓰고」表示「冒著危險」。
135d6040cdee56b2.en: 위험 ends in a final consonant, taking 을 in the fixed expression 을 무릅쓰고.

135d6040cdee56b2.zh: 「이」為主格助詞，此句型固定使用受格助詞「을/를」。
135d6040cdee56b2.en: 이 is a subject particle; this pattern fixedly requires the object particle 을/를.

135d6040cdee56b2.zh: 「에」為副詞格助詞，不符合「을/를 무릅쓰고」的固定搭配。
135d6040cdee56b2.en: 에 is a locative or directional particle, not used with 무릅쓰고.

135d6040cdee56b2.zh: 「과」為表示「和…」的助詞，無法與「무릅쓰고」搭配。
135d6040cdee56b2.en: 과 means and or with, which does not fit the pattern 을/를 무릅쓰고.

14af57689ad9aa90.zh: 「화가 난 나머지」表示極度生氣後的極端行動，「甩門離去」最符合語境。
14af57689ad9aa90.en: Slamming the door and storming out fits the extreme reaction of 화가 난 나머지.

14af57689ad9aa90.zh: 「安靜地微笑」與「氣極之下」的情緒與行為表現完全矛盾。
14af57689ad9aa90.en: Smiling quietly contradicts the state of extreme anger expressed by 화가 난 나머지.

14af57689ad9aa90.zh: 「感謝朋友」與前文極度憤怒的情緒邏輯不相符。
14af57689ad9aa90.en: Thanking a friend contradicts being overwhelmed with anger.

14af57689ad9aa90.zh: 「睡得安穩」無法作為因過度生氣而引發的結果。
14af57689ad9aa90.en: Sleeping comfortably is an unnatural result for someone overwhelmed with anger.

1780f84291c29b1d.zh: 在公司困難的情況下，後半句接續「難以要求加薪」最符合常理情境。
1780f84291c29b1d.en: Given that the company is struggling, saying it is hard to ask for a raise fits logically.

1780f84291c29b1d.zh: 「월급이 올랐어요」與公司陷入困境的前題相互矛盾，語意不合。
1780f84291c29b1d.en: 월급이 올랐어요 contradicts the premise of the company being in difficulty.

1780f84291c29b1d.zh: 「회사가 잘돼요」表示公司營運良好，與前半句「公司困難」直接衝突。
1780f84291c29b1d.en: 회사가 잘돼요 contradicts the condition that the company is struggling (어려운 마당에).

1780f84291c29b1d.zh: 「휴가를 많이 줬어요」與公司面臨困難的尷尬處境毫無邏輯關聯。
1780f84291c29b1d.en: 휴가를 많이 줬어요 lacks logical connection to the awkward situation of a struggling company.

1991f83f7cf3c4ac.zh: 「-기 그지없다」接在形容詞詞幹後，表示極度、無比遺憾惋惜。
1991f83f7cf3c4ac.en: A-기 그지없다 attaches to an adjective stem to mean extremely or beyond measure.

1991f83f7cf3c4ac.zh: 該慣用表現固定使用「없다」，沒有「그지있다」這種形式。
1991f83f7cf3c4ac.en: This idiom is fixed with 없다; the form 그지있다 does not exist.

1991f83f7cf3c4ac.zh: 「은」為冠形詞形字尾，不能與「그지없다」搭配。
1991f83f7cf3c4ac.en: 은 is a noun-modifying suffix and cannot be used before 그지없다.

1991f83f7cf3c4ac.zh: 「게」是副詞形字尾，此句型規定必須接名詞形字尾「기」。
1991f83f7cf3c4ac.en: 게 is an adverbial ending; this specific pattern requires the nominalizer 기.

1d27897245018d8e.zh: 詞幹有收尾音時接「-을뿐더러」，表示「不僅…而且…」。
1d27897245018d8e.en: Stems ending in a consonant take -을뿐더러 to express not only ... but also ....

1d27897245018d8e.zh: 「-는뿐더러」不是正確的文法形態，應依收尾音接「-(으)ㄹ뿐더러」。
1d27897245018d8e.en: There is no form -는뿐더러; the pattern requires -(으)ㄹ뿐더러.

1d27897245018d8e.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ수록」表示「越…越…」，非累加事實的句型。
1d27897245018d8e.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ수록 means the more ..., the more ..., not not only ... but also ....

1d27897245018d8e.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ망정」表示「即使…也…」，表讓步而非並列優點。
1d27897245018d8e.en: The pattern -(으)ㄹ망정 expresses concession (even if / rather than), not addition.

1e16778f0e37a267.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 나머지」表示因過於匆忙而造成「失誤很多」的負面結果。
1e16778f0e37a267.en: -(으)ㄴ 나머지 accurately expresses that rushing excessively caused the negative result of mistakes.

1e16778f0e37a267.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 반면에」表示「相反、另一方面」，前後文並非對比關係。
1e16778f0e37a267.en: 반면에 means on the other hand, which expresses contrast rather than an outcome.

1e16778f0e37a267.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 대신에」表示「代替」或「作為補償」，與因果關係不符。
1e16778f0e37a267.en: 대신에 means instead of or in compensation for, which does not convey consequence.

1e16778f0e37a267.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 이상」表示「既然…就…」，後句通常接應當採取的行動或判斷。
1e16778f0e37a267.en: 이상 means since or now that, typically followed by a resolution or judgment.

1e868fcc8c56efa1.zh: 「아무리」修飾「피곤하기로서니」，受詞「인사도」接否定副詞「안」，語序順暢。
1e868fcc8c56efa1.en: 아무리 precedes 피곤하기로서니, and the object 인사도 directly precedes the negative adverb 안.

21efe2acf7580246.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 법하다」表示理應如此或很有可能，接在「지칠」後完全正確。
21efe2acf7580246.en: -(으)ㄹ 법하다 means it is natural or likely; combined with 지칠 it fits perfectly.

21efe2acf7580246.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 줄 하다」非慣用語，常搭配「알다/모르다」表示知不知道。
21efe2acf7580246.en: 줄 combines with 알다 or 모르다 to indicate knowing how to do something, not with 하다.

21efe2acf7580246.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 리」後多接「없다/있다」，表示毫無道理或可能。
21efe2acf7580246.en: 리 is used in -(으)ㄹ 리 없다/있다 to express impossibility or doubt, not with 하다.

21efe2acf7580246.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 김」不合文法，「-(으)ㄴ/는 김에」表示順便。
21efe2acf7580246.en: 김 is used in -(으)ㄴ/는 김에 to mean while doing something; it cannot take -(으)ㄹ.

221ed4662c93aecb.zh: 受詞「친구를」接動詞片語「기다리다 못해」，修飾副詞「먼저」。
221ed4662c93aecb.en: Object 친구를 attaches to 기다리다 못해 (could not wait any longer), followed by adverb 먼저.

23aa4e9ffefd84c9.zh: 副詞「다시」修飾「만나게 되어」，後接「A-기 그지없다」的形容詞前半部「기쁘기」。
23aa4e9ffefd84c9.en: Adverb 다시 modifies 만나게 되어, which connects naturally to the adjective 기쁘기 in A-기 그지없다.

26b15e419be2de29.zh: 「아이가 깰세라」表擔心孩子醒來，副詞「조용히」修飾關門動作。
26b15e419be2de29.en: 아이가 깰세라 expresses fear of waking the child, and 조용히 modifies closing the door 문을 닫았다.

28d2217216f3561a.en: The stem 들- ends in ㄹ, so it directly takes 뿐더러 to mean not only... but also.
-ㄹ망정 expresses even if or rather than, which does not fit the meaning here.
-ㄹ세라 expresses fear or worry that something might happen.

28d2217216f3561a.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ지언정」表示「縱使…也絕不…」，屬強烈讓步。
28d2217216f3561a.en: -ㄹ지언정 denotes strong concession meaning even if or even though.

29229853451f9814.zh: 「-을/를 무릅쓰고」為固定慣用語，表示「不顧、頂著」。
29229853451f9814.en: 무릅쓰고 completes the fixed expression 을/를 무릅쓰고, meaning in spite of.

29229853451f9814.zh: 「무릅써서」表原因理由，此慣用句型固定使用連接詞尾「-고」。
29229853451f9814.en: 무릅써서 expresses cause or reason; this idiomatic pattern specifically requires -고.

29229853451f9814.zh: 「무릅쓰면」表示假設條件「如果頂著」，語意不符。
29229853451f9814.en: 무릅쓰면 means if one braves, expressing a condition rather than in spite of.

29229853451f9814.zh: 「무릅쓰니」表示原因或發現，不符合慣用句型。
29229853451f9814.en: 무릅쓰니 indicates a cause or discovery, not the idiomatic braving pattern.

2c42327b5845355b.zh: 「늦다」詞幹以子音結尾，需接「-을망정」表示「寧可遲到」。
2c42327b5845355b.en: 늦다 ends in a consonant, so it takes -을망정 to mean would rather be late.

2c42327b5845355b.zh: 不存在「-는망정」的文法形態，動詞詞幹後應接「-을망정」。
2c42327b5845355b.en: -는망정 is an incorrect grammatical form; -을망정 must follow the verb stem.

2c42327b5845355b.zh: 「-을수록」表示「越遲到就越……」，不符合表達寧可選擇較差後果的句意。
2c42327b5845355b.en: -을수록 means the more one is late, which does not convey preferring one bad outcome.

2c42327b5845355b.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 겸」表示「順便、兼做」，在此文意毫無關聯。
2c42327b5845355b.en: -(으)ㄹ 겸 means concurrently or to do something while doing something else, which is irrelevant here.

2c8d8e428382fc6b.zh: 「걷다」接「-노라면」不變形，規則接在動詞詞幹後成「걷노라면」。
2c8d8e428382fc6b.en: The ending -노라면 attaches directly to 걷다's base stem without irregular change.
The final consonant ㄷ does not change to ㄹ before the ending -노라면.

2c8d8e428382fc6b.zh: 韓語中並無「-느라면」這種文法形態。
2c8d8e428382fc6b.en: 느라면 is not a valid grammatical connective ending in Korean.

2c8d8e428382fc6b.zh: 「-노라고」表示自稱盡力做了某事，與句意「如果持續走」不符。
2c8d8e428382fc6b.en: 걷노라고 means one claims to have walked, not 'if you keep walking'.

2d8f63bb4b90709d.zh: 副詞「좀」修飾動詞「쉬어」，接「볼라치면」表每當想休息，後接主詞「일이」與謂語配對。
2d8f63bb4b90709d.en: 좀 modifies 쉬어 볼라치면 (whenever I try to rest), followed by the subject 일이 for the predicate 생겨요.

2da519aa157817b6.zh: 接在「나갈」後構成「-(으)ㄹ세라」，表示擔心洩漏。
2da519aa157817b6.en: Combined with 나갈 to form -(으)ㄹ세라, expressing fear that the secret might leak.
-(으)ㄹ수록 means the more..., which does not make sense here.

2da519aa157817b6.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 겸」表示順便兼做某事，不合句意。
2da519aa157817b6.en: -(으)ㄹ 겸 expresses doing something concurrently or as a dual purpose.
-(으)ㄹ뿐더러 means not only... but also, which is illogical here.

2e400073845ef97b.zh: 副詞「너무」修飾「긴장한」，結合成句型「나머지」再接賓語「이름을」。
2e400073845ef97b.en: 너무 modifies the modifier 긴장한, followed by pattern noun 나머지 and object 이름을.

2e48b730aee6123b.zh: 指示詞「이」修飾「회사에」，接修飾詞「들어온」與「이래로」構成句首起點狀語。
2e48b730aee6123b.en: 이 modifies 회사에, which connects to the modifier 들어온 and pattern 이래로 to set the time frame.

2e76353b1ba946d5.zh: 文法規則為「動詞詞幹 + -아/어 마지않다」，「감사하다」需變為「감사해」。
2e76353b1ba946d5.en: The pattern requires -아/어 마지않다, so 감사하다 conjugates to 감사해.
하고 is a connective ending and cannot combine with 마지않다.

2e76353b1ba946d5.zh: 「하게」是副詞形或使動語尾，不能與「마지않다」結合。
2e76353b1ba946d5.en: 하게 cannot directly connect to 마지않다.

2e76353b1ba946d5.zh: 「하는」是冠形詞形語尾，不能與「마지않다」結合。
2e76353b1ba946d5.en: 하는 is a noun-modifying ending and cannot attach to 마지않다.

3031af796c431b3e.zh: 「목소리를 낮췄다」表示放低聲音，符合擔心被人聽到的反應。
3031af796c431b3e.en: 목소리를 낮췄다 means lowered his voice, fitting the fear of being overheard.

3031af796c431b3e.zh: 「목소리를 높였다」表示提高聲音，與擔心被人聽見矛盾。
3031af796c431b3e.en: 목소리를 높였다 means raised his voice, contradicting the fear of being heard.

3031af796c431b3e.zh: 「크게 웃었다」表示大笑，與怕人聽見而小心的語境相反。
3031af796c431b3e.en: 크게 웃었다 means laughed loudly, which contradicts acting cautiously.

3031af796c431b3e.zh: 「노래를 불렀다」表示唱歌，無法體現擔心被人聽見的行為。
3031af796c431b3e.en: 노래를 불렀다 means sang a song, which is inappropriate if hiding speech.

30ce1f2bd763faed.zh: 慣用語「이유를 막론하고」置於句首，接子句「약속을 어긴」修飾名詞「것은」。
30ce1f2bd763faed.en: 이유를 막론하고 starts the sentence, followed by clause 약속을 어긴 modifying 것은.

31616e9615f77e25.zh: 形容詞詞幹「부족하-」接「-나마」表示「雖然不足，哪怕有欠缺」。
31616e9615f77e25.en: The adjective stem 부족하- takes -나마 to mean even though lacking or limited as I am.

31616e9615f77e25.zh: 「-려고」表示意圖「為了想要……」，接在形容詞後不合文法。
31616e9615f77e25.en: -려고 indicates intention (in order to), which cannot attach to the adjective 부족하다.

31616e9615f77e25.zh: 「-다가」表示動作中途轉移或中斷，不能直接接形容詞表達讓步。
31616e9615f77e25.en: -다가 indicates an interruption or shift of action, which does not fit here.

31616e9615f77e25.zh: 「-도록」表示程度或目的「以便、使得」，與文意不符。
31616e9615f77e25.en: -도록 expresses degree or purpose (so that), which does not express the concession needed.

31d4f72f9632070f.zh: 過去式「다했-」接「-건만」表示雖然已經盡了全力，結果卻不盡人意。
31d4f72f9632070f.en: 다했건만 correctly contrasts a past completed effort with the disappointing final outcome.

31d4f72f9632070f.zh: 「다하건만」為現在式，無法表達過去「盡了全力」的已完成事實。
31d4f72f9632070f.en: 다하건만 lacks past tense, failing to match the past completed effort that preceded the result.

31d4f72f9632070f.zh: 「-거니와」表同向並列，不能用於「盡全力」與「結果不佳」的轉折關係。
31d4f72f9632070f.en: 거니와 adds parallel points and cannot connect an effort with its contradictory bad result.

31d4f72f9632070f.zh: 「-거든」表示條件或理由，無法表達「雖然…但是結果不好」的轉折。
31d4f72f9632070f.en: 거든 introduces a condition, making it unsuitable for this past adversative outcome.

3218091d95c1f0d2.zh: 「더할 나위 없이」為副詞用法，修飾後方的形容詞「만족스러웠다」。
3218091d95c1f0d2.en: 더할 나위 없이 functions as an adverbial phrase modifying the adjective 만족스러웠다.

3218091d95c1f0d2.zh: 此慣用句型固定為否定「없다」，不存在肯定形「더할 나위 있게」。
3218091d95c1f0d2.en: This idiom is fixed in the negative; 더할 나위 있게 is not an idiomatic expression.

3218091d95c1f0d2.zh: 「없어」表示原因或連接，後接形容詞時無法像「없이」那樣作副詞修飾。
3218091d95c1f0d2.en: 없어 is a clausal connective or causal form, not the adverbial modifier 없이.

3218091d95c1f0d2.zh: 「없는」為冠形詞形（定語），後面必須接名詞，不能直接修飾形容詞。
3218091d95c1f0d2.en: 없는 is a noun-modifying form and cannot directly modify the adjective here.

3222ab173a0e1422.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 마당에」表示事已至此的無奈情境，用於反問怪罪他人有何用。
3222ab173a0e1422.en: -(으)ㄴ 마당에 fits the context of pointing out the futility of blaming someone now that things have happened.

3222ab173a0e1422.zh: 「-는 바람에」用於說明導致負面意外結果的具體原因，後接完整子句而非修辭反問。
3222ab173a0e1422.en: -는 바람에 indicates an unexpected cause leading to a negative result, not a rhetorical question.

3222ab173a0e1422.zh: 「-는 통에」表示在混亂吵雜的情況下導致混亂結果，語法通常接「-는」，文意不符。
3222ab173a0e1422.en: -는 통에 describes a hectic or noisy cause, and grammatically does not attach as 된 통에 here.

3222ab173a0e1422.zh: 「-ㄴ 김에」表示順道、趁機做某事，不符合反問怪罪毫無意義的語境。
3222ab173a0e1422.en: -ㄴ 김에 means while taking advantage of an opportunity, which does not fit this resigned context.

3296dd4e3a71da5f.zh: 副詞「밤새」修飾「준비했건만」，後接主語「발표는」與謂語「취소되었다」。
3296dd4e3a71da5f.en: 밤새 modifies 준비했건만, then subject 발표는 connects with the predicate 취소되었다.

3350b2a426a04ff5.zh: 主語「네 말이」接名詞讓步「사실이라손」與「치더라도」。
3350b2a426a04ff5.en: 네 말이 serves as the subject, linking to the noun concession 사실이라손 and 치더라도.

346d65b832accbd8.zh: 「-거니와」前後語氣需一致，前面交通便利，後句同樣接正面的安靜環境。
346d65b832accbd8.en: 거니와 joins facts in the same direction, so the positive clause 주변 환경도 조용하다 matches.

346d65b832accbd8.zh: 「주변이 너무 시끄럽다」為負面評價，與前面稱讚交通便利方向相反。
346d65b832accbd8.en: 주변이 너무 시끄럽다 is negative, which clashes with the positive tone joined by -거니와.

346d65b832accbd8.zh: 「교통이 불편하다」與前一句的「교통도 편리하거니와」產生矛盾。
346d65b832accbd8.en: 교통이 불편하다 directly contradicts the preceding clause stating transportation is convenient.

346d65b832accbd8.zh: 「버스가 잘 안 다닌다」表示交通不便，與前句的交通便利語氣衝突。
346d65b832accbd8.en: 버스가 잘 안 다닌다 contradicts 편리하거니와 by stating buses do not run often.

36a710c40cef977e.zh: 副詞「늦게」無收音，接「나마」表示「雖然遲了，但也……」。
36a710c40cef977e.en: The adverb 늦게 ends without a final consonant, correctly taking 나마 to mean belatedly as it is.

36a710c40cef977e.zh: 「이나마」用於有收音的詞後，「늦게」無收音，應接「나마」。
36a710c40cef977e.en: 이나마 is used after syllables ending with a final consonant; 늦게 ends in a vowel.

36a710c40cef977e.zh: 「조차」表示連……也，多用於極端或負面語境，此處不合禮貌客氣的文意。
36a710c40cef977e.en: 조차 means even in an extreme or negative sense, unsuitable for this polite message.

36a710c40cef977e.zh: 「마저」表示「連最後的……也」，通常帶有負面色彩，不適用於此處。
36a710c40cef977e.en: 마저 implies even the last one remaining, which is inappropriate for this polite announcement.

36e34865adce05ea.zh: 形容詞「바쁘다」接「-다손 치더라도」表「就算再忙」。
36e34865adce05ea.en: 바쁘다 is an adjective, taking -다손 치더라도 to mean even granting that you are busy.

36e34865adce05ea.zh: 「-는다손」是用於動詞現在式的形態，不能接形容詞。
36e34865adce05ea.en: -는다손 is used with verbs, not adjectives like 바쁘다.

36e34865adce05ea.zh: 「-다고서」是表原因或根據的口語，不能與「치더라도」搭配。
36e34865adce05ea.en: -다고서 expresses reason or basis and cannot combine with 치더라도.
-다가 indicates an interruption or transition, not matching 치더라도.

36f9072dbb774772.zh: 「-다 못해」表示再也無法忍受，動詞「참다」接「다 못해」。
36f9072dbb774772.en: The pattern -다 못해 attaches to the verb stem 참- to form 참다 못해 (unable to bear any longer).

36f9072dbb774772.zh: 「-고 못해」不合語法，表忍無可忍的句型應接「-다 못해」。
36f9072dbb774772.en: The connective suffix -고 does not form the idiom meaning unable to endure any longer.

36f9072dbb774772.zh: 「-게 못해」表示「使…無法忍受」，不是自身的忍無可忍。
36f9072dbb774772.en: The ending -게 못하다 means making someone unable to do something, which alters the intended meaning.

36f9072dbb774772.zh: 「-아 못해」不構成此文法，應使用動詞原形接幹的「-다 못해」。
36f9072dbb774772.en: The connector -아 does not combine with 못해 to mean unable to endure any longer.

38fee3bb56c6ca44.zh: 「보다 못해」意為「看不下去而…」，後接親自代勞的行動最符合。
38fee3bb56c6ca44.en: The idiom 보다 못해 means unable to just watch any longer, making doing it instead the natural follow-up.

38fee3bb56c6ca44.zh: 「계속 지켜봤어요」表示繼續看著，與看不下去而採取行動矛盾。
38fee3bb56c6ca44.en: This means continued watching, which directly contradicts 보다 못해 (unable to watch any longer).

38fee3bb56c6ca44.zh: 前文已說弟弟笨拙，後句接「弟弟做得很好」語意前後矛盾。
38fee3bb56c6ca44.en: This contradicts the earlier statement that the younger sibling was clumsy.

38fee3bb56c6ca44.zh: 「나도 못했어요」表示自己也不會，無法順接「看不下去」的行動。
38fee3bb56c6ca44.en: This means I could not do it either, which does not fit the context of stepping in.

3adb469dd0d586fc.zh: 「-었을 턱이 없다」表示「絕不可能做過某事」，符合句意。
3adb469dd0d586fc.en: -(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다 expresses strong denial; 속였을 턱이 없어요 means could not have deceived.

3adb469dd0d586fc.zh: 「턱이 있어요」在陳述句中不自然，通常否定或反問才用 턱。
3adb469dd0d586fc.en: 턱이 있어요 is rarely used in plain statements; 턱 usually takes 없다.

3adb469dd0d586fc.zh: 韓語中沒有「턱을 했어요」這種搭配用法。
3adb469dd0d586fc.en: 턱을 했어요 is not a valid grammatical combination.

3adb469dd0d586fc.zh: 韓語中沒有「턱이 돼요」這種表達方式。
3adb469dd0d586fc.en: 턱이 돼요 is ungrammatical and not an idiom.

3ae95b79a8b4602c.zh: 「-다 못해」表示程度達到極限，甚至超越原狀態而變得慘白。
3ae95b79a8b4602c.en: The pattern -다 못해 is used when a degree goes beyond the extreme, here from pale to ashen.

3ae95b79a8b4602c.zh: 「못하고」表示「未能做到並且」，無法與形容詞搭配表達極限程度。
3ae95b79a8b4602c.en: The form 못하고 expresses inability to do an action and conjunction, which is ungrammatical here.

3ae95b79a8b4602c.zh: 「못하게」表示使得不能，屬於使動或副詞形，無法銜接後項形容詞。
3ae95b79a8b4602c.en: The adverbial ending -게 못하다 expresses preventing an action, not extreme degree.

3ae95b79a8b4602c.zh: 「못하니」表原因，但此處不是因無法變白而蒼白，語意不通。
3ae95b79a8b4602c.en: The ending -니 gives a reason, which does not match the meaning of reaching an extreme degree.

3e250be0e284789d.zh: 符合接續負面情況「밤에는 어두워서 위험하다」的語境。
3e250be0e284789d.en: Correctly adds another dangerous and negative condition matching narrow.

3e250be0e284789d.zh: 「넓고 밝다」與前文的「좁다」語義正面且相反。
3e250be0e284789d.en: 넓고 밝다 means wide and bright, directly contradicting narrow.
아주 안전하다 means very safe, clashing with the negative context.

3e250be0e284789d.zh: 「걷기 편하다」表示舒適好走，無法順接「좁을뿐더러」。
3e250be0e284789d.en: 걷기 편하다 means comfortable to walk on, contradicting the negative first clause.

3ed8d29caadefd54.zh: 條件句「돈이면」修飾受詞「집을」，後接動詞句型「사고도 남아요」。
3ed8d29caadefd54.en: 돈이면 sets the condition, followed by the object 집을 and the verb phrase 사고도 남아요.

40fa1b0f718d79a3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다」為慣用句型，表示「絕不可能、毫無道理」。
40fa1b0f718d79a3.en: 턱이 forms the grammar pattern -(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다 (there is no way that...).

40fa1b0f718d79a3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 나위가 없다」表示「毫無……的必要」，意思不合。
40fa1b0f718d79a3.en: 나위가 belongs to -(으)ㄹ 나위가 없다, meaning no need to...
따름이 is used in -(으)ㄹ 따름이다 (only/merely), not with 없다.

40fa1b0f718d79a3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 겨를이 없다」表示「沒有閒暇、抽不出時間」，語意不符。
40fa1b0f718d79a3.en: 겨를이 forms -(으)ㄹ 겨를이 없다 (no time/leisure to), which doesn't fit here.

42b52a65ecb7bcb3.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 이래로」表示自從某事發生以來，떠나다接「-ㄴ」成「떠난」。
42b52a65ecb7bcb3.en: -(으)ㄴ 이래로 means ever since; the verb stem 떠나 takes -ㄴ to modify 이래로.

42b52a65ecb7bcb3.zh: 「-는」是現在式冠形詞尾，而「이래로」需接過去完成的「-(으)ㄴ」。
42b52a65ecb7bcb3.en: -는 is the present-tense modifier, whereas 이래로 requires the past modifier -(으)ㄴ.

42b52a65ecb7bcb3.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ」表示將來或推測，不能與表示過去起點的「이래로」搭配。
42b52a65ecb7bcb3.en: -(으)ㄹ indicates future or prospective action, which cannot pair with 이래로.

42b52a65ecb7bcb3.zh: 「-아서/어서」表示原因或先後順序，無法直接修飾名詞「이래로」。
42b52a65ecb7bcb3.en: -아서 connects sequential or causal clauses and cannot directly modify 이래로.

43bcc785aa21d9d9.zh: 「아무리」與反詰讓步「힘든들」呼應，後接「여기서 포기할 수는 없어요」。
43bcc785aa21d9d9.en: 아무리 pairs naturally with the concession 힘든들, followed by 여기서 포기할 connecting to 수는 없어요.

46088d85d062ce33.zh: 「無論地位高低」後應接全體適用的內容，故「大家都要守規矩」最合理。
46088d85d062ce33.en: After 'regardless of status', everyone must follow the rules fits logically.

46088d85d062ce33.zh: 「只有老闆守規矩」與「無論地位」所指的無例外原則互相矛盾。
46088d85d062ce33.en: 'Only the boss follows the rules' contradicts 'regardless of status'.

46088d85d062ce33.zh: 「沒有規矩」無法承接前句強調無例外的語意脈絡。
46088d85d062ce33.en: 'There are no rules' does not logically follow 'regardless of status'.

46088d85d062ce33.zh: 「地位高」只是單純陳述狀態，語意不完整且不合邏輯。
46088d85d062ce33.en: 'Status is high' does not form a meaningful sentence here.

4645d1740b4147bd.zh: 「-ㄴ들」反詰句後句常接反問「難道追得上嗎？」，表示不可能追上。
4645d1740b4147bd.en: A rhetorical question like 잡을 수 있겠어요? naturally completes the -ㄴ들 concession pattern.

4645d1740b4147bd.zh: 「잡았어요」為陳述肯定事實，與前半句「即使追去…」的反詰意義衝突。
4645d1740b4147bd.en: 잡았어요 states a positive past achievement, conflicting with the futile concession.

4645d1740b4147bd.zh: 「잡을게요」表示說話者意圖，無法與反詰讓步子句相呼應。
4645d1740b4147bd.en: 잡을게요 is a statement of intention, which does not fit the rhetorical context.

4645d1740b4147bd.zh: 「잡고 있어요」表示正在抓，文意與反詰前設矛盾。
4645d1740b4147bd.en: 잡고 있어요 is a present progressive statement, not fitting the rhetorical nuance.

4658653cfec68262.zh: 「속는 셈 치고」為固定表達，意為「就當作被騙一次」。
4658653cfec68262.en: 치고 completes the fixed construction 속는 셈 치고 (even if being fooled).

4658653cfec68262.zh: 「이고」為敘述格助詞加連接詞尾，無法與「셈」構成該慣用語。
4658653cfec68262.en: 이고 is the copula with -고 and does not form the idiom 셈 치다.

4658653cfec68262.zh: 「하고」表示「做…並…」，不符合「셈 치다」的用法。
4658653cfec68262.en: 하고 means doing and, not matching the required verb 치다.

4658653cfec68262.zh: 「되고」意為「成為…並…」，不能代換慣用語中的「치고」。
4658653cfec68262.en: 되고 means becoming and, which cannot replace 치고 here.

49e685d3d513199d.zh: 「딴청을 피웠다」意為假裝不知道、裝糊塗，符合「裝作沒聽到」的語境。
49e685d3d513199d.en: 딴청을 피웠다 means feigned ignorance or looked away, matching the context.

49e685d3d513199d.zh: 「대답을 잘했다」表示好好回答，與前面「像沒聽見一樣」語意矛盾。
49e685d3d513199d.en: 대답을 잘했다 means answered well, which contradicts pretending not to hear.

49e685d3d513199d.zh: 「귀를 기울였다」表示側耳傾聽，與前面「像沒聽見一樣」衝突。
49e685d3d513199d.en: 귀를 기울였다 means listened intently, opposite to pretending not to hear.

49e685d3d513199d.zh: 「고개를 끄덕였다」表示點頭表示同意，與「像沒聽見」矛盾。
49e685d3d513199d.en: 고개를 끄덕였다 means nodded one's head, which contradicts not hearing.

4fad8e6bd43089c0.zh: 後句表就算做了讓步，結果仍然困難，語意完整契合。
4fad8e6bd43089c0.en: Correctly states the consequence that arriving on time is still difficult despite leaving now.

4fad8e6bd43089c0.zh: 「일찍 도착했다」為過去肯定，與假設讓步矛盾。
4fad8e6bd43089c0.en: 일찍 도착했다 is past tense arrived early, contradicting the hypothetical present condition.

4fad8e6bd43089c0.zh: 「출발하지 않았다」表示尚未出發，與前述假設邏輯衝突。
4fad8e6bd43089c0.en: 출발하지 않았다 means did not depart, which contradicts the premise of departing now.

4fad8e6bd43089c0.zh: 「지금 출발한다」單純重複出發，未呈現讓步後的結論。
4fad8e6bd43089c0.en: 지금 출발한다 merely repeats leaving now without stating a resulting consequence.

50f714d17aa73bb1.zh: 副詞「비록」修飾「작은 가게일망정」以表示讓步，後接主語「손님이」及述語。
50f714d17aa73bb1.en: 비록 introduces the concession in 작은 가게일망정, followed by the subject 손님이 and predicate 많아요.

511950b5990ef069.zh: 「-아/어 마지않다」為書面鄭重表達「衷心…」，接於「바라」後。
511950b5990ef069.en: -아/어 마지않습니다 is the formal written pattern meaning sincerely or from the bottom of one's heart.

511950b5990ef069.zh: 「마지있다」不是正確的文法詞彙，固定用法為否定形「마지않다」。
511950b5990ef069.en: 마지있다 does not exist; the pattern is fixed as the negative 마지않다.

511950b5990ef069.zh: 「-도록」表示目的或程度的連接詞尾，無法直接做句子結尾。
511950b5990ef069.en: -도록 is a connective suffix for purpose or degree, not a sentence ending.

511950b5990ef069.zh: 「마지못하다」表示「不得已、勉強」，與衷心祝願句意完全相反。
511950b5990ef069.en: 마지못하다 means reluctantly or grudgingly, opposing the intended sincere wish.

54d624a31290d8b4.zh: 動詞「후회하다」去「다」加「-ㄴ들」，形成反詰讓步。
54d624a31290d8b4.en: Verb stem 후회하- ends in a vowel, so it takes -ㄴ들 to form the rhetorical concession.
하는들 is grammatically incorrect; the ending is -(으)ㄴ들, not -는들.
할들 is an incorrect grammatical form.

54d624a31290d8b4.zh: 「-해들」是不正確的結合方式，母音結尾動詞幹應接「-ㄴ들」。
54d624a31290d8b4.en: 해들 is an incorrect form; verbs take -(으)ㄴ들 directly on the stem.

54f5f54de9e8eec6.zh: 修飾詞「처음」修飾動詞「가 보는」，再修飾名詞「곳인」，接「터라」。
54f5f54de9e8eec6.en: The adverb 처음 modifies 가 보는, which modifies the noun phrase 곳인 before connecting to 터라.

554470dad7b8425e.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 셈 치다」為固定句型，表示「就當作是…」。
554470dad7b8425e.en: 셈 completes the grammatical idiom -(으)ㄴ 셈 치다 (treat it as if).
척 is used in -(으)ㄴ 척하다 (pretend to), not with 치다.

554470dad7b8425e.zh: 「만큼」表示程度或「正如…」，無法接「치고」構成此文法。
554470dad7b8425e.en: 만큼 expresses degree or amount and cannot form this expression with 치다.
대로 means in accordance with, not forming a structure with 치다.

5574612370814845.zh: 慣用語「-고도 남다」表示「…還有餘、綽綽有餘」，在此接在먹-後最恰當。
5574612370814845.en: -고도 남다 is a set pattern meaning more than enough to, attaching directly to 먹-.

5574612370814845.zh: 「자마자」表示「一…就…」，接在南下（남다）前無法表達份量充足的語意。
5574612370814845.en: 자마자 means as soon as, which does not make sense with 남아요.

5574612370814845.zh: 「다가」表示動作中途中斷或轉移，與後面的 남다 無法搭配表達充足之意。
5574612370814845.en: 다가 indicates an interrupted action and does not form the idiom of having more than enough.

5574612370814845.zh: 「느라」表示因忙於某動作而導致負面結果，在此無法與 남다 構成合適句意。
5574612370814845.en: 느라 indicates a reason for a negative outcome, which cannot combine logically with 남아요.

5598ee7232b992cb.zh: 主語「하늘이」後接「무너질 듯이」作比喻修飾，再接主詞與動詞「천둥이 쳤다」。
5598ee7232b992cb.en: 하늘이 combines with 무너질 듯이, which adverbially modifies the clause 천둥이 쳤다.

5648c4e680a46ea8.zh: 副詞 그냥 修飾 참자니，接結果 화가 나고 形成對稱，再接後續的 따지자니。
5648c4e680a46ea8.en: 그냥 modifies 참자니, followed by the result 화가 나고 before the parallel 따지자니 clause.

565ec11b20f474ad.zh: 「-인 터라」表示背景原因，後句須為陳述客觀事實的「실수가 많았다」。
565ec11b20f474ad.en: The explanatory clause -인 터라 naturally pairs with a descriptive statement like 실수가 많았다.

565ec11b20f474ad.zh: 「-인 터라」後句通常不用於命令句「실수하지 마세요」。
565ec11b20f474ad.en: -인 터라 explains a state or reason and is unnatural with imperative forms like 실수하지 마세요.
-인 터라 expresses background causes and cannot end with a propositive ending like 실수하자.

565ec11b20f474ad.zh: 「-인 터라」後句不適合接提議或詢問意圖的「실수할까요」。
565ec11b20f474ad.en: -인 터라 explains background circumstances, making the suggestion 실수할까요 inappropriate.

577ff0d70176ce83.zh: 助詞「도」可加入「-(으)ㄹ 법하다」中構成「법도 하다」，加強語氣。
577ff0d70176ce83.en: The particle 도 can be added into the pattern to form -(으)ㄹ 법도 하다 for emphasis.

577ff0d70176ce83.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 법이 하다」不是正確的韓語慣用搭配。
577ff0d70176ce83.en: -(으)ㄹ 법이 하다 is ungrammatical; the subject marker 이 is not used with 하다 here.

577ff0d70176ce83.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 법을 하다」不是正確的語法結構。
577ff0d70176ce83.en: -(으)ㄹ 법을 하다 is ungrammatical; 법 does not take the object marker 을 before 하다.

577ff0d70176ce83.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 법도 있다」並非該慣用語，應使用動詞「하다」。
577ff0d70176ce83.en: The idiom is -(으)ㄹ 법하다 (or 법도 하다), not with the verb 있다.

58f2b249af681685.zh: 主詞「그는」引導受詞「위험을」與句型「무릅쓰고」，接名詞「불」以修飾「속으로」。
58f2b249af681685.en: Subject 그는 precedes object 위험을 and 무릅쓰고, followed by noun 불 modifying 속으로.

5a5727047a8d20be.zh: 「살다」詞幹收尾音為「ㄹ」，連接「-(으)ㄹ망정」時組合為「살망정」。
5a5727047a8d20be.en: 살다 has a stem ending in ㄹ, so it directly attaches to -(으)ㄹ망정 as 살망정.

5a5727047a8d20be.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ망정」沒有「-는망정」的形態變化，屬於錯誤文法接續。
5a5727047a8d20be.en: The pattern is -(으)ㄹ망정, not -는망정; this is an incorrect grammatical form.

5a5727047a8d20be.zh: 「-길래」表示原因或理由，意為「因為生活」，文意完全不通順。
5a5727047a8d20be.en: -길래 expresses a cause or reason, meaning because I live, which does not fit the context.

5a5727047a8d20be.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ수록」表示「越……越……」，與後續「想要正直生活」語意不合。
5a5727047a8d20be.en: -(으)ㄹ수록 means the more..., which makes no sense before wanting to live honestly.

5ab4cbd4612f0d33.zh: 「남녀노소」無收音，搭配慣用語「-을/를 막론하고」需用受格助詞「를」。
5ab4cbd4612f0d33.en: 남녀노소 ends in a vowel, so it takes the object marker 를 in 을/를 막론하고.

5ab4cbd4612f0d33.zh: 「가」是主格助詞，而「막론하고」前面必須接受格助詞 을/를。
5ab4cbd4612f0d33.en: 가 is a subject marker; the fixed expression requires the object marker 을/를.

5ab4cbd4612f0d33.zh: 「에」是副詞格助詞，不能用於「-을/를 막론하고」句型。
5ab4cbd4612f0d33.en: 에 is a locative/directional marker, incompatible with 을/를 막론하고.

5ab4cbd4612f0d33.zh: 「와」表示「和」，在此不能代替受格助詞「를」。
5ab4cbd4612f0d33.en: 와 means 'and/with', but this idiom requires the object marker 를.

5b5a42140f00d1b3.zh: 「위협을 무릅쓰고」為固定搭配，表示「冒著生命的威脅」。
5b5a42140f00d1b3.en: 무릅쓰고 forms the set grammar pattern N을/를 무릅쓰고 (braving N).

5b5a42140f00d1b3.zh: 「무릅써도」表示讓步「即使頂著」，不符合該文法結構。
5b5a42140f00d1b3.en: 무릅써도 means even if one braves, which breaks the standard idiom.

5b5a42140f00d1b3.zh: 「무릅쓰니」表示原因或背景，非固定慣用形式。
5b5a42140f00d1b3.en: 무릅쓰니 introduces a reason or discovery rather than braving in spite of.
무릅쓸수록 means the more one braves, which does not make sense here.

5ca911cd902c154f.zh: 主詞「수업이」接動詞片語「끝나기가 무섭게」表一結束就，後接新主詞「학생들이」。
5ca911cd902c154f.en: 수업이 goes with 끝나기가 무섭게 to indicate the first event, followed by 학생들이 as the subject of running out.

61910a53c6130985.zh: 持續閱讀就會不知不覺忘記時間，符合「-노라면」自然引發的結果。
61910a53c6130985.en: 시간 가는 줄 모른다 describes losing track of time while continuously reading.

61910a53c6130985.zh: 「時間很多」是單純的狀態陳述，無法作為持續讀書後引發的自然結果。
61910a53c6130985.en: 시간이 많았다 is a simple past statement and does not logically follow.

61910a53c6130985.zh: 「買了書」是過去發生的具體事件，與持續讀書的過程無關。
61910a53c6130985.en: 책을 샀다 is a past action that does not follow from the act of reading.

61910a53c6130985.zh: 「沒有書」與前半句「讀著書」相互矛盾。
61910a53c6130985.en: 책이 없다 directly contradicts the preceding clause about reading a book.

63bd2352cb785739.zh: 副詞「잠시나마」修飾整個動作，連接地點「고향에」與能力句型「다녀올 수」。
63bd2352cb785739.en: The adverbial phrase 잠시나마 sets the concession, followed by the destination 고향에 and the verb phrase 다녀올 수.

63ed13f14d1db684.zh: 賓語「기상 관측을」接謂語「시작한」，再接「이래」表示自開始氣象觀測以來的起點。
63ed13f14d1db684.en: The object 기상 관측을 precedes the verb modifier 시작한, which modifies 이래 to express ever since.

649c852c6c803f9e.en: 이 책은 is the topic, followed by 재미있을뿐더러 which connects to the secondary property 유익하기도.

659ad0d8d07b27b2.en: 그 가게는 forms the subject, followed by 친절할뿐더러 and the second subject 가격도.

66b35a5c3f345ec7.en: 살다 drops its final ㄹ before endings starting with ㄴ, giving 사노라면.

66b35a5c3f345ec7.zh: 「살다」與「-노라면」結合時「ㄹ」必須脫落，不可保留。
66b35a5c3f345ec7.en: 살다 must drop its final ㄹ before ㄴ, making 살노라면 ungrammatical.

66b35a5c3f345ec7.zh: 韓語中並無「-느라면」這一文法形態。
66b35a5c3f345ec7.en: 사느라면 is incorrect because -느라면 is not an existing grammatical ending.

66b35a5c3f345ec7.zh: 「-ㄹ라치면」表示剛打算做某事時就發生了別的事，語意不合。
66b35a5c3f345ec7.en: 살라치면 means 'whenever one is about to live', which does not fit.

6738b1bc6212abd6.zh: 前半句有「幸好…否則」，後半句需接「差點弄丟（-ㄹ 뻔했다）」。
6738b1bc6212abd6.en: 날릴 뻔했어요 correctly completes the pattern with -(으)ㄹ 뻔했다 (almost lost).

6738b1bc6212abd6.zh: 「날렸어요」表示已經弄丟了，與前面有備份的事實矛盾。
6738b1bc6212abd6.en: 날렸어요 states that you actually lost the files, contradicting having a backup.

6738b1bc6212abd6.zh: 「날리고 있어요」表示現在正在弄丟，文意不合邏輯。
6738b1bc6212abd6.en: 날리고 있어요 means 'I am losing them right now', which does not fit.

6738b1bc6212abd6.zh: 「날릴게요」表示說話者的意志「我會弄丟」，與文意不合。
6738b1bc6212abd6.en: 날릴게요 expresses a future intention or promise to lose files, which makes no sense.

686f86c3f16ca484.zh: 「여러분의」修飾受詞「건강과 행복을」，再接動詞「바라」構成句型。
686f86c3f16ca484.en: 여러분의 modifies 건강과 행복을, which forms the object for 바라 before 마지않습니다.

69454237b7888b1f.zh: 「시간이 없다」為留下來的負面結果，與前文「떠나자니 아쉽고」形成兩難對比。
69454237b7888b1f.en: 시간이 없다 expresses the difficulty of staying, properly completing the dilemma structure.

69454237b7888b1f.zh: 「시간이 많다」表示時間充裕，與前面想留卻不行的糾結語境矛盾。
69454237b7888b1f.en: 시간이 많다 means having plenty of time, which contradicts the hesitant, torn tone.

69454237b7888b1f.zh: 「정말 좋다」表示非常好，無法體現「더 있자니」所帶來的顧慮或負面結果。
69454237b7888b1f.en: 정말 좋다 expresses a purely positive reaction, failing to show the negative side of staying.

69454237b7888b1f.zh: 「떠나고 싶다」表示想離開，與前文「떠나자니 아쉽고」（離開又捨不得）語意衝突。
69454237b7888b1f.en: 떠나고 싶다 means wanting to leave, conflicting with the reluctance stated earlier.

69457fa0b1cc6c20.zh: 形容詞「고프다」語幹直接接「-기로서니」，表示「就算肚子餓也不能…」。
69457fa0b1cc6c20.en: The adjective stem 고프- directly takes -기로서니 to express even if hungry.

69457fa0b1cc6c20.zh: 「-기로서니」前不需要加冠形詞尾「-ㄴ」，「고픈기로서니」形式錯誤。
69457fa0b1cc6c20.en: -기로서니 attaches directly to the stem; 고픈기로서니 is an ungrammatical form.

69457fa0b1cc6c20.zh: 沒有「-아서니」這種語法形式，文法錯誤。
69457fa0b1cc6c20.en: -아서니 does not exist as a grammatical ending in Korean.

69457fa0b1cc6c20.zh: 「-(으)려고」表示意圖「打算…」，放入句中語法和邏輯均不合。
69457fa0b1cc6c20.en: -(으)려고 expresses intention (intending to), which does not make sense here.

6a72ad90649194b1.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ망정」承認身形矮小但強調力氣大，語意對比自然。
6a72ad90649194b1.en: -(으)ㄹ망정 admits the weakness of being short to emphasize the contrasting strength of being powerful.

6a72ad90649194b1.zh: 「힘도 약하다」也是缺點，無法與前半句形成強調優點的轉折對比。
6a72ad90649194b1.en: 힘도 약하다 describes another weakness, failing to create the intended contrast highlighting a strength.

6a72ad90649194b1.zh: 「키가 작다」重複前半句已提及的矮小事實，語意冗贅且無意義。
6a72ad90649194b1.en: 키가 작다 merely repeats that the person is short, making the sentence redundant and meaningless.

6a72ad90649194b1.zh: 「운동을 못한다」是另一個負面描述，無法接續「-(으)ㄹ망정」強調長處。
6a72ad90649194b1.en: 운동을 못한다 is another negative trait and does not provide the positive contrast required after -(으)ㄹ망정.

6c1f15862e440a6d.zh: 「-다는 듯이」表示「像是……似地」，接在間接引語後修飾「웃었다」。
6c1f15862e440a6d.en: 듯이 follows the indirect quotation ending 없었다는 to mean as if nothing had happened.

6c1f15862e440a6d.zh: 韓語中沒有「척에」這種表達方式，裝作某事應用「척하다」。
6c1f15862e440a6d.en: 척에 is ungrammatical; pretending requires the form -는 척하다.

6c1f15862e440a6d.zh: 「-던/는 김에」表示順便、趁機，在此語境下文意不通。
6c1f15862e440a6d.en: 김에 means while one is at it or taking the opportunity, which does not fit.

6c1f15862e440a6d.zh: 「-은/는 탓에」表示壞結果的原因（怪罪），與句子笑的語意不合。
6c1f15862e440a6d.en: 탓에 blames a cause for a bad result, which does not match this context.

6dfb47fd49a28975.zh: 「몇 번이나」修飾「말했건만」，再接主詞「그는」與後文謂語結合。
6dfb47fd49a28975.en: 몇 번이나 modifies 말했건만, followed by subject 그는 linking to 듣지 않았다.

6e551ac1f294671d.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 겨를이 없다」表示沒有閒暇、抽不出時間。
6e551ac1f294671d.en: -(으)ㄹ 겨를이 없어요 correctly means having no time or leisure to rest.

6e551ac1f294671d.zh: 「겨를이 많아요」不合自然習慣，且與前面「太忙」語義矛盾。
6e551ac1f294671d.en: 겨를이 많아요 means having lots of leisure time, which contradicts being busy.
겨를 cannot be used with the verb 하다.

6e551ac1f294671d.zh: 「겨를이 돼요」不是自然慣用語，通常與「있다/없다」搭配。
6e551ac1f294671d.en: 겨를이 돼요 is unnatural; 겨를 collogates with 없다 or rarely 있다.

6fcc4c98d98ff690.zh: 符合「A-기 그지없다」句型，詞幹「불쾌하-」後需接「기」。
6fcc4c98d98ff690.en: Matches the pattern A-기 그지없다; stem 불쾌하- requires nominalizing suffix 기.

6fcc4c98d98ff690.zh: 「게」為副詞形字尾，不能用在此慣用句型中。
6fcc4c98d98ff690.en: 게 is an adverbial suffix and does not fit the pattern A-기 그지없다.

6fcc4c98d98ff690.zh: 「는」為動詞現在式定語字尾，不適用於形容詞且無法接「그지없다」。
6fcc4c98d98ff690.en: 는 is a present modifier for verbs and cannot attach here to precede 그지없다.

6fcc4c98d98ff690.zh: 「고」表示並列連接，無法與後方的「그지없었다」構成句型。
6fcc4c98d98ff690.en: 고 is a connective ending and cannot form this construction with 그지없었다.

6fdfd284bb88c722.zh: 「-고도 남다」表示綽綽有餘，接在「가고도」後面非常合適。
6fdfd284bb88c722.en: 남아요 completes -고도 남다 to mean more than enough to go there.

6fdfd284bb88c722.zh: 「모자라요」表示不足，不能與慣用句型「-고도 남다」搭配。
6fdfd284bb88c722.en: 모자라요 means insufficient and does not form the idiom -고도 남다.

6fdfd284bb88c722.zh: 「부족해요」表示不夠、缺乏，無法構成「-고도 남다」句型。
6fdfd284bb88c722.en: 부족해요 means lacking and does not complete the pattern -고도 남다.

6fdfd284bb88c722.zh: 「늦어요」表示遲到或太晚，語意與固定句型皆不相符。
6fdfd284bb88c722.en: 늦어요 means to be late, which makes no sense with 가고도.

701c0a5211464cb7.zh: 「-기로서니」後句需接責備、質疑過分行為的反問句，此選項符合文意。
701c0a5211464cb7.en: This rhetorical reproach matches the grammar -기로서니, criticizing an excessive action.

701c0a5211464cb7.zh: 「물건을 던졌어요」僅是陳述句，無法承接「-기로서니」的反詰責備語氣。
701c0a5211464cb7.en: 물건을 던졌어요 is just a plain declarative statement, not the expected reproach.

701c0a5211464cb7.zh: 「화가 났어요」與前文「화가 났기로서니」重複，語意不通順。
701c0a5211464cb7.en: 화가 났어요 awkwardly repeats the premise 화가 났기로서니 without providing a consequence.

701c0a5211464cb7.zh: 「참았어요」意為忍耐了，與「-기로서니」責怪對方做過頭的用法相反。
701c0a5211464cb7.en: 참았어요 means endured, contradicting the reproachful tone required by -기로서니.

725e48774dd209ec.zh: 指示詞「그」修飾名詞「돈은」，搭配過去定語「잃어버린」接續「셈 치고」。
725e48774dd209ec.en: The demonstrative 그 modifies 돈은, followed by the past modifier 잃어버린 modifying the pattern 셈 치고.

78b0d84a23e060cf.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ라치면」後常接妨礙或不如意的事，「他總是避開」語意最合適。
78b0d84a23e060cf.en: -(으)ㄹ라치면 is followed by an obstacle or annoyance; 그는 꼭 자리를 피한다 fits perfectly.

78b0d84a23e060cf.zh: 「聽完了我的話」表示順利完成，不符合後方接阻礙或打擾的用法。
78b0d84a23e060cf.en: This indicates a smooth, completed action, which contradicts the frustrating obstacle nuance of -(으)ㄹ라치면.

78b0d84a23e060cf.zh: 「我說了話」語意重複且不完整，無法與前半句的條件連貫。
78b0d84a23e060cf.en: This is redundant and unnatural following whenever I try to bring it up.

78b0d84a23e060cf.zh: 「故事結束了」與前面「我每次想要開口說」缺乏合理的因果關聯。
78b0d84a23e060cf.en: This doesn't form a sensible result for whenever I try to bring up a topic.

7b3405a30c4579e6.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 법하다」前面必須接動詞的將來冠形詞形「이해할」。
7b3405a30c4579e6.en: The pattern requires the future modifier ending -(으)ㄹ, so 이해할 is correct.

7b3405a30c4579e6.zh: 「이해하는」是現在冠形詞形，不可與「법하다」搭配使用。
7b3405a30c4579e6.en: 이해하는 is the present modifier form and cannot precede 법하다.

7b3405a30c4579e6.zh: 「이해한」是過去冠形詞形，無法搭配句型「-(으)ㄹ 법하다」。
7b3405a30c4579e6.en: 이해한 is the past modifier form and cannot combine with -(으)ㄹ 법하다.

7b3405a30c4579e6.zh: 「이해해」是非格式體或非終結形式，無法作為冠形詞修飾「법하다」。
7b3405a30c4579e6.en: 이해해 is not an adnominal form and cannot modify 법.

7ba34b15c12425da.zh: 體言「사장」接指定詞「이다」，其冠形詞形為「인」，構成「인 듯이」。
7ba34b15c12425da.en: 인 is the modifier form of 이다 after the noun 사장, making 사장인 듯이.

7ba34b15c12425da.zh: 「이는」是代名詞或主格接助詞，不能接在名詞後形成冠形詞修飾「듯이」。
7ba34b15c12425da.en: 이는 is not the adnominal form of 이다; it cannot precede 듯이 here.

7ba34b15c12425da.zh: 「이고」是並列連接詞尾，不能直接接名詞修飾語「듯이」。
7ba34b15c12425da.en: 이고 is a connective ending (and), not an adnominal form modifying 듯이.

7ba34b15c12425da.zh: 「이라」是引用或敘述縮略形，無法直接連接「듯이」。
7ba34b15c12425da.en: 이라 cannot directly precede 듯이 as an adnominal modifier.

7e77e633eb7e1be0.zh: 主語「이 노래는」接「남녀노소를 막론하고」，修飾後續謂語「사랑받는다」。
7e77e633eb7e1be0.en: Subject 이 노래는 precedes the adverbial phrase 남녀노소를 막론하고 before 사랑받는다.

7ebe9aaf215690e6.zh: 「-노라면」表示若持續做某事，後續將會帶來相應的結果。
7ebe9aaf215690e6.en: 노라면 indicates that continuing an action will eventually yield a certain result.

7ebe9aaf215690e6.zh: 「-느라고」用於說明造成負面結果的原因，不表正面期許。
7ebe9aaf215690e6.en: 느라고 indicates a reason leading to a negative result, which does not fit.

7ebe9aaf215690e6.zh: 「-거니와」表示不僅……而且……，無法引導未來的假設結果。
7ebe9aaf215690e6.en: 거니와 means 'not only... but also', and cannot introduce a future condition.

7ebe9aaf215690e6.zh: 「-건만」表示雖然……卻帶來令人遺憾的轉折，此處並非轉折。
7ebe9aaf215690e6.en: 건만 introduces an unexpected contrary result, not a continuing condition.

7ed2448ef6e765de.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다」表示絕不可能，動詞 하다 後接「할」。
7ed2448ef6e765de.en: The pattern is -(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다, so 하다 becomes 할.

7ed2448ef6e765de.zh: 「하는」是現在式定語形，不能與「턱이 없다」搭配。
7ed2448ef6e765de.en: 하는 is the present modifier and cannot precede 턱이 없다.

7ed2448ef6e765de.zh: 「한」是過去式定語形，與句意要表達的「絕不可能說謊」不符。
7ed2448ef6e765de.en: 한 is the past modifier; here we need -(으)ㄹ with 턱이 없다.

7ed2448ef6e765de.zh: 「해」是非格式體終結詞尾，無法修飾後面的依存名詞 턱。
7ed2448ef6e765de.en: 해 is a sentence ending and cannot modify the dependent noun 턱.

7f720102a1d7204f.zh: 受詞「우산을」接動詞「가져왔기에」，連接「망정이지」後接次句受詞「비를」。
7f720102a1d7204f.en: Object 우산을 precedes verb 가져왔기에, followed by 망정이지, which then leads into the second clause's object 비를.

81b4ff1def1a1fad.zh: 副詞「이미」修飾冠形詞「헤어진」引導「마당에」，後接疑問詞「무슨」修飾「미련」。
81b4ff1def1a1fad.en: 이미 modifies the adnominal 헤어진 before 마당에, which is followed by the interrogative determiner 무슨 modifying 미련.

82aae9ac848be4e9.zh: 「-ㄹ라치면」表示每當想要做某事時總會發生阻礙，接在母音後用「할라치면」。
82aae9ac848be4e9.en: Use 할라치면 because -(으)ㄹ라치면 attaches to verb stems without a batchim to mean whenever I try to.

82aae9ac848be4e9.zh: 「한라치면」並非正確的語法形態，應使用「할라치면」。
82aae9ac848be4e9.en: 한라치면 is grammatically incorrect; the pattern requires -(으)ㄹ라치면, giving 할라치면.

82aae9ac848be4e9.zh: 「하라고」表示引用命令或「叫……去做」，與後文的阻礙語意不符。
82aae9ac848be4e9.en: 하라고 expresses an indirect command telling someone to do something, which does not fit here.

82aae9ac848be4e9.zh: 「할수록」表示「越……越……」，與後面的下雨狀況無法搭配。
82aae9ac848be4e9.en: 할수록 means the more one does, which does not convey the meaning of whenever trying to go out.

83020c0596e38955.zh: 「국적」有終聲收音，接慣用型「-을/를 막론하고」需用「을」。
83020c0596e38955.en: 국적 ends in a consonant, so it takes 을 in the pattern 을/를 막론하고.

83020c0596e38955.zh: 「이」是主格助詞，此慣用句型必須搭配受格助詞 을/를。
83020c0596e38955.en: 이 is a subject marker; this pattern specifically takes the object marker 을.

83020c0596e38955.zh: 「에」是副詞格助詞，無法與動詞「막론하고」搭配。
83020c0596e38955.en: 에 is a directional/locative particle and cannot precede 막론하고.

83020c0596e38955.zh: 「과」表示「和」，此處需填入受格助詞「을」。
83020c0596e38955.en: 과 means 'with/and'; the pattern requires the object particle 을.

845498882e3e4770.zh: 形容詞 쉽다 為 ㅂ 不規則，接「-(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다」時變為「쉬울」。
845498882e3e4770.en: 쉽다 is an irregular ㅂ adjective, combining with -(으)ㄹ to become 쉬울.

845498882e3e4770.zh: 「운」是修飾名詞的現在形（쉬운），不能接「턱이 없다」。
845498882e3e4770.en: 운 makes the modifier 쉬운, which does not fit -(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다.

845498882e3e4770.zh: 「워서」表示原因（쉬워서），無法修飾依存名詞 턱。
845498882e3e4770.en: 워서 forms 쉬워서 showing cause, which cannot modify 턱.

845498882e3e4770.zh: 「웠던」是過去回想定語形，不能用於「-(으)ㄹ 턱이 없다」句型。
845498882e3e4770.en: 웠던 is a past retrospective modifier and cannot be used here.

86f10b085dd10d6f.zh: 主語「그의 성실함은」置於句首，搭配慣用語「말할 나위도」接「없다」。
86f10b085dd10d6f.en: The subject phrase 그의 성실함은 links naturally to the idiom 말할 나위도 before 없다.

87e8a33f42944d4c.zh: 文法「-(으)ㄴ 이래(로)」表示自從過去某事發生以來，動詞「오다」應接「온」。
87e8a33f42944d4c.en: The grammar pattern -(으)ㄴ 이래(로) requires the past modifier form; 오다 becomes 온.

87e8a33f42944d4c.zh: 「오는」是現在進行定語形，此句型規定必須接過去定語形「-(으)ㄴ」。
87e8a33f42944d4c.en: 오는 is the present modifier form; -(으)ㄴ 이래(로) requires the past modifier form.

87e8a33f42944d4c.zh: 「올」是未來或推測定語形，不能用於表示自過去某事以來的「이래(로)」。
87e8a33f42944d4c.en: 올 is the future modifier form, which cannot be used with 이래(로).

87e8a33f42944d4c.zh: 「와」是動詞詞幹非格式體形，不能直接修飾依託名詞「이래」。
87e8a33f42944d4c.en: 와 is an informal verb conjugation, not a modifier form that can precede 이래.

88ba5763ba150173.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 나머지」表示因過度驚訝而導致後面說不出話的結果。
88ba5763ba150173.en: -(으)ㄴ 나머지 expresses that extreme shock led to the negative outcome of being speechless.

88ba5763ba150173.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 김에」表示「順便」，此處前後並非趁機做某事的關係。
88ba5763ba150173.en: -(으)ㄴ 김에 means while one is at it, which does not fit an involuntary reaction.

88ba5763ba150173.zh: 「덕분에」表示「多虧（正面原因）」，與後方說不出話的負面結果不合。
88ba5763ba150173.en: 덕분에 means thanks to for positive outcomes, unfitting for being unable to speak.

88ba5763ba150173.zh: 「대로」表示「按照」或「一…就…」，無法表達因情緒過度而導致結果。
88ba5763ba150173.en: 대로 means as or as soon as, which cannot express an excessive emotional cause.

8a89aa3252377fea.zh: 「말할 나위도 없다」為固定慣用語，動詞需接將來式定語「-(으)ㄹ」。
8a89aa3252377fea.en: 말할 나위도 없다 is a fixed idiom requiring the modifier ending -(으)ㄹ on 말하다.

8a89aa3252377fea.zh: 「말한」為過去式定語字尾，不符合此固定慣用表現的文法結構。
8a89aa3252377fea.en: 말한 is a past-tense modifier and cannot be used in this set idiom.

8a89aa3252377fea.zh: 「말하는」為現在式定語字尾，不能與「나위도 없다」搭配。
8a89aa3252377fea.en: 말하는 is a present-tense modifier and does not fit the pattern.

8a89aa3252377fea.zh: 「말해」為非格式體口語連接口吻，無法直接修飾名詞「나위」。
8a89aa3252377fea.en: 말해 is an informal clause ending and cannot directly modify dependent noun 나위.

8b7232f21ee45737.zh: 「-거니와」表示不僅內容好，演技也很優秀，前後語氣一致地並列遞進。
8b7232f21ee45737.en: 거니와 correctly connects two positive qualities in parallel, meaning not only... but also.

8b7232f21ee45737.zh: 「-거든」表示條件「如果…的話」，在此句不合邏輯與文意。
8b7232f21ee45737.en: 거든 expresses a condition (if/once), which does not fit this additive statement.

8b7232f21ee45737.zh: 「-건만」表示轉折「雖然…但是」，前後文意皆為正面讚賞，不宜轉折。
8b7232f21ee45737.en: 건만 expresses an adversative contrast (although), but both clauses here express positive praise.

8b7232f21ee45737.zh: 「-거나」表示選擇「或者」，不合「內容與演技皆好」的並列意思。
8b7232f21ee45737.en: 거나 indicates an alternative (or), not an addition of two good traits.

8bf5dcc864945cc1.zh: 「사자니」搭配結果「돈이 없고」，再接否定對比「안」與句尾「사자니」呼應。
8bf5dcc864945cc1.en: 사자니 pairs with 돈이 없고, then 안 leads into the parallel clause 사자니 아쉬워요.

8c87779ac364d733.zh: 「돈도 없는데」做背景前句，接受詞「해외여행을」與修飾詞「갈」接「턱이 있겠어요?」。
8c87779ac364d733.en: Background clause 돈도 없는데 connects to 해외여행을 and modifier 갈 before 턱이 있겠어요?.

8e576cde3a31662f.zh: 「안 하자니」與前文「말하자니」形成否定對比，構成「說也不是，不說也不是」。
8e576cde3a31662f.en: 안 하자니 contrasts with 말하자니 to form the balanced dilemma pattern of saying vs. not saying.

8e576cde3a31662f.zh: 「안 하자고」表示提議「不要做吧」，與後文表達心情鬱悶的답답하다無法銜接。
8e576cde3a31662f.en: 안 하자고 means proposing not to do it, which does not link logically to feeling frustrated.

8e576cde3a31662f.zh: 「안 하자마자」意為「一不做就」，語義不通且不符合兩難句型。
8e576cde3a31662f.en: 안 하자마자 means as soon as not doing it, which makes no sense here.

8e576cde3a31662f.zh: 「안 하던」是過去回想修飾名詞的冠形詞形，後方接形容詞답답하다語法不符。
8e576cde3a31662f.en: 안 하던 is a noun-modifying form, which cannot directly precede the predicate 답답하다.

90e4c27d0e7f5b50.zh: 副詞「미리」修飾「알려 줬기에」，再接慣用句型「망정이지」。
90e4c27d0e7f5b50.en: Adverb 미리 modifies the compound verb 알려 줬기에, which takes 망정이지 to form the pattern.

916f706bb5a9fda6.zh: 狀語「일에」修飾「몰두한」，構成「-(으)ㄴ 나머지」再接名詞「점심」。
916f706bb5a9fda6.en: 일에 connects to 몰두한, forming the modifier clause before 나머지, followed by 점심.

91cd4d5a57ab40df.zh: 「-기 무섭게」表示一拿到就立刻發生，「花光了」最符合立即發生的後續動作。
91cd4d5a57ab40df.en: 다 써 버렸어요 logically completes the pattern expressing an immediate action right after getting paid.

91cd4d5a57ab40df.zh: 「要領薪水了」使用未來時制，與表示剛做完前事的「-기 무섭게」衝突。
91cd4d5a57ab40df.en: This uses future tense, contradicting the immediate past sequence set by 받기 무섭게.

91cd4d5a57ab40df.zh: 「薪水很少」是狀態描述，不能作「-기 무섭게」後緊接著發生的動作。
91cd4d5a57ab40df.en: This is a static description, not an immediate consequence or event following 받기 무섭게.

91cd4d5a57ab40df.zh: 「是下個月」語意不通，無法與一拿到薪水的時間點連接。
91cd4d5a57ab40df.en: This does not make semantic sense as an immediate action after receiving salary.

9217612f6250ff39.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ라치면」後常接妨礙該意圖的偶發狀況，「一定有人來訪」最相符。
9217612f6250ff39.en: -(으)ㄹ라치면 is typically followed by an unwelcome interruption, like someone visiting.

9217612f6250ff39.zh: 「吃飽了」是吃完後的狀態，與「每當想吃飯時」的干擾情境不合。
9217612f6250ff39.en: 배가 불러요 means being full, which cannot be an interruption that happens whenever one tries to eat.

9217612f6250ff39.zh: 「很美味」是在吃飯時或吃完的感想，不合句型表達干擾或打斷的用法。
9217612f6250ff39.en: 맛있어요 evaluates food, whereas the pattern requires an obstacle occurring upon trying to eat.

9217612f6250ff39.zh: 「吃飯」重複了前面的動作，語意同語反覆且無法構成相應後句。
9217612f6250ff39.en: 밥을 먹어요 redundantly repeats eating rather than providing an interfering event.

94d9d99fc9ec2642.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 셈 치다」為固定慣用句型，表示「就當作…」。
94d9d99fc9ec2642.en: 치고 is the correct verb form in the set expression -(으)ㄴ 셈 치다.

94d9d99fc9ec2642.zh: 「이고」為名詞述語連接形，無法構成「就當作…」的慣用表達。
94d9d99fc9ec2642.en: 이고 is the copula and conjunction, not forming the idiomatic phrase.

94d9d99fc9ec2642.zh: 「이라서」表示「因為是…」，無法表達假定或自我寬慰的語意。
94d9d99fc9ec2642.en: 이라서 gives a reason (because it is), unlike the suppositional 셈 치다.

94d9d99fc9ec2642.zh: 「하고」表示「做並…」，此處固定使用動詞「치다」。
94d9d99fc9ec2642.en: 하고 means and doing; the grammar point exclusively uses 치다.

960b370ea0bf987a.zh: 「말할 나위도 없다」為固定慣用語，表示「不用說、不言而喻」。
960b370ea0bf987a.en: 말할 나위도 없다 is a fixed idiom meaning it goes without saying.

960b370ea0bf987a.zh: 此句型慣用否定結尾「없다」，改成肯定「있다」不合慣用語。點。
960b370ea0bf987a.en: The pattern conventionally takes the negative 없다; using 있다 is not idiomatic here.

960b370ea0bf987a.zh: 句型前須接未來冠詞形「-(으)ㄹ」，不可接現在冠詞形「-는」。
960b370ea0bf987a.en: The pattern requires the prospective modifier -(으)ㄹ, not the present modifier -는.

960b370ea0bf987a.zh: 此句型應為「없다」結尾，接過去式「했다」非慣用用法且語意不通。
960b370ea0bf987a.en: The idiom requires 없다, not a past action verb like 했다.

96482c4a6e90dbec.zh: 「-기로서니」後接責備過分舉動的「말을 그렇게 함부로 하면 안 되지」。
96482c4a6e90dbec.en: This option expresses the appropriate reproach: one shouldn't speak so carelessly.

96482c4a6e90dbec.zh: 「친하게 지냈다」僅陳述過去相處融洽，無法銜接前句的讓步責難。
96482c4a6e90dbec.en: 친하게 지냈다 merely states a past friendly relationship and lacks the reproachful tone.

96482c4a6e90dbec.zh: 「사이가 좋다」是陳述關係好，前後文意矛盾且無因果責怪之意。
96482c4a6e90dbec.en: 사이가 좋다 simply describes a good relationship, failing to complete the -기로서니 pattern.

96482c4a6e90dbec.zh: 「자주 만났다」表示經常見面，與「-기로서니」所引導的批評語氣不符。
96482c4a6e90dbec.en: 자주 만났다 means met often, which does not fit the critical clause required by -기로서니.

9735284f14b6848f.zh: 「못 먹다」為已發生的過去事情，須用過去冠形詞尾「-(으)ㄴ」形成「먹은 터라」。
9735284f14b6848f.en: For completed actions explaining a situation, the past adnominal form -(으)ㄴ is used: 먹은 터라.

9735284f14b6848f.zh: 「먹는」表示正在進行或現在習慣，與過去挨餓的情況不合。
9735284f14b6848f.en: 먹는 denotes present or ongoing actions, which does not fit an already missed breakfast.

9735284f14b6848f.zh: 「먹을」表示未來或預想，不能用來表示已經沒吃早餐的事實背景。
9735284f14b6848f.en: 먹을 expresses future or unrealized actions, unsuitable for an event that already occurred.

9735284f14b6848f.zh: 「먹어」是連接或非終結形，不能直接接在依存名詞「터」前。
9735284f14b6848f.en: 먹어 is an informal or connective verb form and cannot directly modify the dependent noun 터.

98f5e353fc88b161.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 겨를도 없었다」表示連避開的時間都沒有，符合句意。
98f5e353fc88b161.en: -(으)ㄹ 겨를도 없었다 expresses not having even a moment to avoid it.

98f5e353fc88b161.zh: 「겨를도 있었다」表示連閒暇都有，與突然發生事故的語境矛盾。
98f5e353fc88b161.en: 겨를도 있었다 means there was even time, contradicting the sudden accident context.

98f5e353fc88b161.zh: 「겨를이 많았다」表示時間很充裕，與句意完全相反。
98f5e353fc88b161.en: 겨를이 많았다 means having plenty of time, which contradicts the sudden context.
겨를 cannot be paired with the verb 하다.

99013c929fd035b4.zh: 「-건만」後應接違背預期的遺憾結果，因此「燒沒退」正確。
99013c929fd035b4.en: 건만 requires an unexpected, regretful outcome, so 'the fever did not drop' fits.

99013c929fd035b4.zh: 「燒馬上退了」是合乎預期的順利結果，無法與「-건만」搭配。
99013c929fd035b4.en: 열이 금방 내렸다 is an expected positive result, contradicting 건만.

99013c929fd035b4.zh: 「身體變好了」是吃藥後的正常正面結果，與「-건만」語氣不合。
99013c929fd035b4.en: 몸이 좋아졌다 expresses an expected positive result, incompatible with 건만.

99013c929fd035b4.zh: 「全都痊癒了」是吃藥後的正面結果，與轉折的「-건만」矛盾。
99013c929fd035b4.en: 다 나았다 is an expected positive outcome, conflicting with the regret in 건만.

996118d49a3972ad.zh: 指示詞「그」修飾受詞「소식을」，接動詞「듣고」再接句型前半「슬프기」。
996118d49a3972ad.en: Determiner 그 modifies object 소식을, followed by connective verb 듣고 and pattern starter 슬프기.

9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.zh: 「-다(가) 못해」表示忍無可忍或到極限，接詞幹後用「다」。
9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.en: The pattern -다 못해 expresses reaching the limit of enduring something; 기다리다 combines with 못해.

9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.zh: 「-고 못해」不是正確的文法搭配，應使用「-다 못해」。
9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.en: The connective -고 does not form this idiomatic grammar pattern with 못해.

9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.zh: 「-게 못해」表示不讓某人做某事，無法表達自己忍耐到極限。
9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.en: The form -게 못하다 means preventing someone from doing something, not reaching one's limit.

9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.zh: 「-니 못해」不是表示忍耐到極限的慣用語法。
9a2b27ec9be8b0c5.en: The suffix -니 indicates reason or discovery and cannot combine with 못해 in this pattern.

9a8d15399fe73d14.zh: 「-을/를 막론하고」為固定慣用語，表示「無論……都不例外」。
9a8d15399fe73d14.en: 을/를 막론하고 is the standard fixed idiom meaning 'regardless of'.

9a8d15399fe73d14.zh: 「막론해서」表原因或順序，此固定慣用句型固定用「막론하고」。
9a8d15399fe73d14.en: 막론해서 expresses cause or sequence; the idiom strictly uses 막론하고.

9a8d15399fe73d14.zh: 「막론하면」表條件「如果無論」，並非正確的慣用句型。
9a8d15399fe73d14.en: 막론하면 means 'if you disregard', which is not the idiomatic form.

9a8d15399fe73d14.zh: 「막론하니」表理由「因為無論」，與慣用語用法不合。
9a8d15399fe73d14.en: 막론하니 gives a reason ('since...'), which is not used in this expression.

9b50888a56aaeca6.zh: 「눕-」後接「기가」構成「-기(가) 무섭게」，表示剛躺下就立刻睡著。
9b50888a56aaeca6.en: 기가 correctly attaches to the stem 눕- to form the pattern -기(가) 무섭게.

9b50888a56aaeca6.zh: 「는」無法直接與後面的「무섭게」組成表示「一……就……」的句型。
9b50888a56aaeca6.en: 는 cannot combine with 무섭게 to express the immediate sequence.

9b50888a56aaeca6.zh: 「게」在此無法形成合乎文法的搭配，該句型需用名詞形字尾「-기(가)」。
9b50888a56aaeca6.en: 게 cannot be used with 무섭게 in this grammatical structure.

9b50888a56aaeca6.zh: 「자」本身表「一……就」，不能後面直接再加「무섭게」。
9b50888a56aaeca6.en: 자 cannot be combined with 무섭게; the set pattern requires -기(가).

9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.zh: 「창피함」有收音，搭配「을 무릅쓰고」表示「不顧羞恥」。
9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.en: 창피함 ends in a consonant and takes 을 in the pattern 을 무릅쓰고.

9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.zh: 「이」為主格助詞，該文法固定接受格助詞「을/를」。
9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.en: 이 is a subject marker; the pattern requires the object marker 을/를.

9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.zh: 「에」為副詞格助詞，不能與「무릅쓰고」搭配使用。
9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.en: 에 is a locative/directional particle and cannot attach to 무릅쓰고.

9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.zh: 「으로」表示工具或方向，不符合此固定句型。
9ba7e3f2149d7cb3.en: 으로 marks direction or means, which does not fit the expression.

a1a6a62389d58eae.zh: 主語「이 식당은」接並列子句「음식도 맛있거니와」，再連至「가격도 싸다」。
a1a6a62389d58eae.en: The topic 이 식당은 leads into 음식도 맛있거니와, which smoothly parallels the following 가격도 싸다.

a1e6d95f92b819d9.zh: 主詞「제가」後接「존경해 마지않는」修飾賓語「선생님을」。
a1e6d95f92b819d9.en: Subject 제가 leads into the relative clause 존경해 마지않는 modifying 선생님을 before 소개합니다.

a1eb5871244e100c.zh: 副詞「다」修飾過去式定語「끝난」，接「마당에」構成慣用語，再接時間副詞「이제」。
a1eb5871244e100c.en: Adverb 다 modifies 끝난, attaching to 마당에 in V-(으)ㄴ 마당에, followed by temporal adverb 이제.

a54d0edac11da76b.zh: 主語「그는」接「성실하거니와」，後引出並列特質「책임감도 강하다」。
a54d0edac11da76b.en: The subject 그는 attaches to 성실하거니와, which pairs with the added trait 책임감도 강하다.

a572811b80ddebe0.zh: 「말할 나위도 없다」為固定慣用句型，否定詞固定使用「없다」。
a572811b80ddebe0.en: 말할 나위도 없다 is a set idiom meaning needless to say, fixed with 없다.

a572811b80ddebe0.zh: 該慣用句型固定為否定形式，韓語中沒有「말할 나위가 있다」的用法。
a572811b80ddebe0.en: This idiom only exists in the negative; 있어요 does not form a natural expression.

a572811b80ddebe0.zh: 「아니에요」是「不是」，無法與表示空間/餘地的「나위」搭配。
a572811b80ddebe0.en: 아니에요 means is not, which does not grammatically pair with 나위.

a572811b80ddebe0.zh: 「돼요」是「可以/行」，無法與「말할 나위도」構成慣用搭配。
a572811b80ddebe0.en: 돼요 means to work or become, which does not form this idiom.

a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.zh: 「법하다」修飾名詞「광경」時，應轉為冠形詞形「법한」。
a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.en: To modify the following noun 광경, the adjective 법하다 takes the modifier ending -ㄴ to become 법한.

a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.zh: 「법이」是名詞加主格助詞，後面直接接名詞「광경」不符合語法。
a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.en: 법이 is a noun with the subject particle and cannot directly modify the noun 광경.

a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.zh: 「법인」是「법이다」的冠形形，但此處句型是形容詞「법하다」而非體詞述語。
a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.en: 법인 comes from the copula 법이다, but the correct grammar pattern here is the adjective 법하다.

a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.zh: 「법해」是非格式體非終結形，不能直接置於名詞「광경」前作修飾語。
a7fe5a1b5eb77a08.en: 법해 is an informal ending and cannot act as an adnominal modifier before the noun 광경.

a91e5bf0d6b1194d.zh: 與「-기」搭配構成慣用型「-기 무섭게」，表示新品一上市立刻賣光。
a91e5bf0d6b1194d.en: 무섭게 completes the fixed grammar pattern -기 무섭게, meaning as soon as.

a91e5bf0d6b1194d.zh: 「무서워서」表示「因為害怕所以……」，與商品上市售罄的語境無關。
a91e5bf0d6b1194d.en: 무서워서 means because one is scared, which makes no sense in this context.

a91e5bf0d6b1194d.zh: 「무섭도록」表示「到了令人害怕的程度」，非表示時間緊接著的慣用語法。
a91e5bf0d6b1194d.en: 무섭도록 means to a scary degree, which does not express the immediate temporal sequence.

a91e5bf0d6b1194d.zh: 「무서운」是形容詞修飾名詞的冠形詞形，後方為動詞「다 팔렸다」，文法不合。
a91e5bf0d6b1194d.en: 무서운 is an adjectival modifier and cannot naturally connect to the verb phrase 다 팔렸다.

a9e5afea060f4a3c.zh: 形容詞詞幹「춥-」直接加「-거니와」，表示天氣冷而且風也大。
a9e5afea060f4a3c.en: The adjective stem 춥- attaches directly to 거니와 to express cold weather in addition to strong wind.

a9e5afea060f4a3c.zh: 形容詞詞幹不可接「-은거니와」，應直接接「-거니와」。
a9e5afea060f4a3c.en: Adjective stems attach directly to -거니와, making 추운거니와 grammatically incorrect.

a9e5afea060f4a3c.zh: 「-건만」表示轉折，然而後半句「風也大」同屬惡劣天氣，非反差事實。
a9e5afea060f4a3c.en: 건만 indicates contrast, but cold weather and strong wind are parallel harsh conditions.

a9e5afea060f4a3c.zh: 「-거든」表示條件假定，接在描寫既定事實的句中並不自然。
a9e5afea060f4a3c.en: 거든 expresses a condition, which does not fit this factual description.

aa56f94a1f061f01.zh: 「-기 그지없다」為固定句型，形容詞詞幹後需接名詞形字尾「기」。
aa56f94a1f061f01.en: A-기 그지없다 is a fixed pattern requiring the nominalizing suffix 기 on the adjective stem.

aa56f94a1f061f01.zh: 「게」是副詞形字尾，不能與「그지없다」搭配使用。
aa56f94a1f061f01.en: 게 is an adverbial suffix and does not form this grammatical pattern with 그지없다.

aa56f94a1f061f01.zh: 「은」是冠形詞形（定語）字尾，不能直接接「그지없다」。
aa56f94a1f061f01.en: 은 is a noun-modifying suffix and cannot directly precede 그지없다.

aa56f94a1f061f01.zh: 「고」用於並列或連接子句，無法與「그지없다」構成慣用語。
aa56f94a1f061f01.en: 고 is a connective suffix for listing and cannot combine with 그지없다 here.

aa58a2eeb933415d.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ망정」承認鄉下學校的不便，後半句強調「設備極佳」的長處。
aa58a2eeb933415d.en: -(으)ㄹ망정 concedes the limitation of being a rural school to highlight the strength of great facilities.

aa58a2eeb933415d.zh: 「시설도 낡았다」接續另一項缺點，無法形成承認劣勢並突顯優點的對比。
aa58a2eeb933415d.en: 시설도 낡았다 adds another negative aspect, failing to highlight an offsetting strength.

aa58a2eeb933415d.zh: 「학생이 없다」純粹描寫負面狀況，失去「-(으)ㄹ망정」突顯長處的功能。
aa58a2eeb933415d.en: 학생이 없다 describes a negative situation, missing the positive emphasis needed after -(으)ㄹ망정.

aa58a2eeb933415d.zh: 「도시에 있다」與前半句「鄉下學校」自相矛盾，文意不通。
aa58a2eeb933415d.en: 도시에 있다 directly contradicts the premise of being a country school (시골 학교).

ab79ec503cd12aa1.zh: 動詞「떠나다」表達當前或即將發生的狀態時，接冠形法現在式「-는」。
ab79ec503cd12aa1.en: The verb 떠나다 takes the present attributive ending -는 before 마당에 to mean now that you are leaving.

ab79ec503cd12aa1.zh: 「-기」為名詞形字尾，無法直接修飾依存名詞「마당에」。
ab79ec503cd12aa1.en: -기 is a nominalizer and cannot directly modify the dependent noun 마당에.

ab79ec503cd12aa1.zh: 「-고」為並列連接詞尾，不能用來修飾「마당에」。
ab79ec503cd12aa1.en: -고 is a connective ending and cannot form an adnominal clause modifying 마당에.

ab79ec503cd12aa1.zh: 「-어」為非正式詞尾或連接詞尾，不能直接修飾名詞「마당에」。
ab79ec503cd12aa1.en: -어 is an informal or connective suffix, unable to modify the dependent noun 마당에.

acccece6f1a71ec6.zh: 副詞「지금」修飾「후회한들」，「무슨 소용이」銜接後面的反問句尾。
acccece6f1a71ec6.en: 지금 modifies 후회한들, which takes the rhetorical clause 무슨 소용이 leading into 있겠어요?.

afabd040174b28d1.zh: 「몸은 피곤할망정」表示退一步承認疲憊，後接「마음은 편해요」突顯內心舒坦。
afabd040174b28d1.en: 몸은 피곤할망정 concedes physical fatigue, followed by 마음은 편해요 to highlight the contrasting mental comfort.

b054f34614b4ee89.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ라치면」表示「每當想要…時」，母音結尾動詞接「-ㄹ라치면」。
b054f34614b4ee89.en: -(으)ㄹ라치면 means whenever I try to do something; 하다 becomes 할라치면.

b054f34614b4ee89.zh: 韓語中沒有「-는라치면」這種形態，該句型必須接「-(으)ㄹ」。
b054f34614b4ee89.en: -는라치면 is ungrammatical; the pattern exclusively attaches via -(으)ㄹ.

b054f34614b4ee89.zh: 韓語中沒有「-ㄴ라치면」這種詞尾組合，形態錯誤。
b054f34614b4ee89.en: -ㄴ라치면 is incorrect because this pattern takes prospective -(으)ㄹ, not -ㄴ.

b054f34614b4ee89.zh: 「-었/았더니」表示「做完某事後發現」，無法表達「每當想要做…」的反覆性。
b054f34614b4ee89.en: -했더니 expresses an observed outcome after doing an action once, not a recurring attempt.

b2cf95996f69ef6a.zh: 主詞「네가」接副詞「얼마나」與間接疑問「힘들었을지」，再接「알고도 남아」。
b2cf95996f69ef6a.en: 네가 is the subject, 얼마나 modifies 힘들었을지, and together they connect into 알고도 남아.

b3a4305a39a4c6c1.zh: 「-(으)ㄹ 겨를이 없다」表示太忙而抽不出時間。
b3a4305a39a4c6c1.en: -(으)ㄹ 겨를이 없다 correctly expresses having no time or leisure to do something.

b3a4305a39a4c6c1.zh: 「나위」通常用於「-(으)ㄹ 나위가 없다」（毫無餘地/無需贅言）。
b3a4305a39a4c6c1.en: 나위 is used in -(으)ㄹ 나위가 없다, meaning no need or no room for doubt.

b3a4305a39a4c6c1.zh: 「따름」用於「-(으)ㄹ 따름이다」，表示「只是、僅僅而已」。
b3a4305a39a4c6c1.en: 따름 is used in -(으)ㄹ 따름이다 to mean only or merely.

b3a4305a39a4c6c1.zh: 「마련」通常用於「-기 마련이다」，表示「理所當然如此」。
b3a4305a39a4c6c1.en: 마련 is used in -기 마련이다 to mean naturally bound to happen.

b43f23cb0c912cf7.zh: 「겨를」前方需接動詞未來時制冠形詞形「-(으)ㄹ」，故用「잘」。
b43f23cb0c912cf7.en: 겨를 requires a verb with the future noun-modifying ending -(으)ㄹ, giving 잘.

b43f23cb0c912cf7.zh: 「자는」是現在時態冠形詞形，不能接「겨를」。
b43f23cb0c912cf7.en: 자는 is the present noun-modifying form, which cannot modify 겨를.

b43f23cb0c912cf7.zh: 「잔」是過去時態冠形詞形，不能接「겨를」。
b43f23cb0c912cf7.en: 잔 is the past noun-modifying form, which cannot modify 겨를.

b43f23cb0c912cf7.zh: 「자서」是連接語尾，不能修飾後面的名詞「겨를」。
b43f23cb0c912cf7.en: 자서 is a connective verb ending and cannot modify the noun 겨를.

b4b628b9b72e9dba.zh: 「-다 못해」表示程度極端，「餓到甚至發痛」最符合情境。
b4b628b9b72e9dba.en: The pattern -다 못해 indicates an extreme state, perfectly completed by saying it even hurt.

b4b628b9b72e9dba.zh: 「배가 불렀다」表示吃飽了，與「肚子餓到極點」語意矛盾。
b4b628b9b72e9dba.en: This means being full, which directly contradicts being hungry to the extreme.

b4b628b9b72e9dba.zh: 「밥을 남겼다」表示剩飯，與極度飢餓的常理不符。
b4b628b9b72e9dba.en: This means leaving food uneaten, which conflicts with extreme hunger.

b4b628b9b72e9dba.zh: 「간식을 거절했다」表示拒絕點心，無法體現飢餓程度之深。
b4b628b9b72e9dba.en: Refusing a snack does not naturally follow being so hungry that it reaches an extreme.

b57be167462a7ffb.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ 마당에」表示「事到如今的情況下」，接在冠形詞「끝난」後最適當。
b57be167462a7ffb.en: -(으)ㄴ 마당에 expresses now that it has come to this situation after the modifier 끝난.

b57be167462a7ffb.zh: 「-는 김에」表示「順便趁機」，與「事情已結束、道歉何用」的斥責語氣不符。
b57be167462a7ffb.en: -는 김에 means taking the opportunity to do something, which clashes with the rhetorical tone.

b57be167462a7ffb.zh: 「덕분에」表示「託……的福」，多用於正面感謝，無法用於事情終結的無奈質問。
b57be167462a7ffb.en: 덕분에 means thanks to (a positive cause), which does not fit this reproachful situation.

b57be167462a7ffb.zh: 「대로」表示「按照、一……就……」，代入句中文法與語意皆不通順。
b57be167462a7ffb.en: 대로 means as or as soon as, which makes no sense in this context.

b74d4d75b3e9073e.zh: 名詞「잠깐」有收音，表示「哪怕只是短暫地」應接「이나마」。
b74d4d75b3e9073e.en: 잠깐 ends in a final consonant, so 이나마 is attached to mean even if only briefly.

b74d4d75b3e9073e.zh: 「나마」用於無收音的名詞後，有收音的「잠깐」應接「이나마」。
b74d4d75b3e9073e.en: 나마 is used after nouns without a final consonant; 잠깐 ends in a consonant and requires 이나마.

b74d4d75b3e9073e.zh: 「이야말로」表示強調「正是、確實是」，在此處語義不合。
b74d4d75b3e9073e.en: 이야말로 expresses strong emphasis meaning truly or indeed, which does not fit the intended meaning.

b74d4d75b3e9073e.zh: 「조차」表示連最基本的也……，通常用於極端或負面情況。
b74d4d75b3e9073e.en: 조차 means even or not even, usually used in extreme or negative contexts.

b79ee697a59cc460.zh: 「사자니」接於動詞幹後，與後面的「안 사자니」呼應表達兩難。
b79ee697a59cc460.en: 사자니 attaches directly to the verb stem, pairing with 안 사자니 to express a dilemma.

b79ee697a59cc460.zh: 「사는자니」是不存在的語法形式，-자니 直接接在詞幹後。
b79ee697a59cc460.en: 사는자니 is grammatically incorrect; -자니 attaches directly to the stem 사-.

b79ee697a59cc460.zh: 「사자고」表示提議或目的「為了買」，無法與後句對比形成兩難。
b79ee697a59cc460.en: 사자고 expresses a proposal or intention, which does not fit the two-sided dilemma context.

b79ee697a59cc460.zh: 「사자마자」表示「一…就…」，強調時間先後而非進退兩難。
b79ee697a59cc460.en: 사자마자 means as soon as buying, which denotes immediate time sequence, not a dilemma.

b7d63e87a0de6feb.zh: 副詞「정신없이」修飾「일하느라」，再接賓語「밥」與修飾語「먹을」連接後文。
b7d63e87a0de6feb.en: 정신없이 modifies 일하느라 to show hectic work, followed by object 밥 and modifier 먹을 before 겨를.

b8128e8af7d5ccf8.zh: 名詞結尾無收音或有收音皆可接「-(이)ㄴ들」，「왕」有收音接「인들」。
b8128e8af7d5ccf8.en: Nouns take -(이)ㄴ들 for rhetorical concession; 왕 ends in a consonant, so it takes 인들.

b8128e8af7d5ccf8.zh: 「이들」意思是「這些人」，非文法讓步助詞。
b8128e8af7d5ccf8.en: 이들 means 'these people', not the grammatical concession marker.

b8128e8af7d5ccf8.zh: 「일들」名詞複數型表示「事情們」，非助詞型態。
b8128e8af7d5ccf8.en: 일들 is a noun meaning 'tasks' or 'matters', not the concession particle.

b8128e8af7d5ccf8.zh: 名詞無「-은들」形式，名詞需使用「-(이)ㄴ들」。
b8128e8af7d5ccf8.en: 은들 is an invalid form; nouns combine with -(이)ㄴ들, not -은들.

b83c982a60737f42.zh: 主語條件「그 사람이라면」接副詞「충분히」再修飾謂語「그럴 법해요」。
b83c982a60737f42.en: 그 사람이라면 sets the condition, followed by adverb 충분히 modifying 그럴 before 법해요.

bb2f4c6ec1d603ff.zh: 動詞「오다」有尾音形式接「-ㄴ다손 치더라도」。
bb2f4c6ec1d603ff.en: The verb 오다 takes -ㄴ다손 before 치더라도 to express even granting that he comes.

bb2f4c6ec1d603ff.zh: 「손」不能單獨直接接在動詞詞幹後面。
bb2f4c6ec1d603ff.en: 손 alone cannot attach directly to a verb stem without the quoting ending -다-.

bb2f4c6ec1d603ff.zh: 「-다면서」表引用並確認事實「聽說…」，與後文不合。
bb2f4c6ec1d603ff.en: -다면서 means while saying that or confirming what was heard, not matching 치더라도.
-다니 expresses surprise or rationale and cannot form this concessive construction.

bb5d36669ba3c3d6.zh: 「겨를도 없이」是固定副詞用法，表示連…的工夫都沒有就立刻做某事。
bb5d36669ba3c3d6.en: 겨를도 없이 is an adverbial phrase meaning without even a moment to do something.

bb5d36669ba3c3d6.zh: 「없게」表目的或狀態，無法自然修飾後續突然發生的動作。
bb5d36669ba3c3d6.en: 없게 indicates purpose or manner, which does not fit this idiomatic phrase.

bb5d36669ba3c3d6.zh: 韓語中不存在「있이」這種詞形，副詞應為「있게」。
bb5d36669ba3c3d6.en: 있이 is not a valid Korean adverb form.

bb5d36669ba3c3d6.zh: 「없어」表原因連接，但此處固定搭配副詞形「없이」修飾「대답했다」。
bb5d36669ba3c3d6.en: 없어 expresses cause, whereas the idiomatic adverbial form 없이 is needed.

bc46b00ba0210ce6.zh: 名詞「개교」直接接「이래」，表示「自建校以來」。
bc46b00ba0210ce6.en: N 이래 means ever since N; 개교 이래 correctly means since the school opened.

bc46b00ba0210ce6.zh: 「대로」表示「按照、正如」，接在「개교」後語義不通。
bc46b00ba0210ce6.en: 대로 means according to or as, which makes no sense after 개교.

bc46b00ba0210ce6.zh: 「만큼」表示程度「如同……那樣」，不符合自開校以來的時間起點語義。
bc46b00ba0210ce6.en: 만큼 expresses extent or degree (as much as), not a starting point in time.

bc46b00ba0210ce6.zh: 「탓에」表示「因為……的緣故（負面結果）」，不符合句意。
bc46b00ba0210ce6.en: 탓에 means due to (a negative cause), which does not fit the context.

bdf3fc631a03f0b7.zh: 「-거니와」用於並列兩種優秀特質，表示實力出眾且人品也好。
bdf3fc631a03f0b7.en: 거니와 properly connects two positive qualities: outstanding ability and fine character.

bdf3fc631a03f0b7.zh: 「-건만」表示轉折對比，與後句讚美其人品的文意不相符。
bdf3fc631a03f0b7.en: 건만 creates an adversative contrast, which contradicts the second positive compliment.

bdf3fc631a03f0b7.zh: 「-거든」表示假設條件「如果」，無法表達既有優點的並列累加。
bdf3fc631a03f0b7.en: 거든 marks a condition (if), failing to convey the cumulative addition of traits.

bdf3fc631a03f0b7.zh: 「-고자」表示意圖或目的「想要…」，不能用於單純並列兩項特點。
bdf3fc631a03f0b7.en: 고자 indicates an intention or purpose (in order to), which is ungrammatical here.

bee36b03cedc5683.zh: 修飾語「부모님의」修飾「반대를」，後接固定慣用語「무릅쓰고」與受詞「유학을」。
bee36b03cedc5683.en: 부모님의 modifies 반대를, followed by the pattern 무릅쓰고 and object 유학을.

c1b9fb9cf8548b42.zh: 「거짓말을 하자니 마음이 불편하다」呈現出說謊的顧慮，完美對應前半句的兩難情境。
c1b9fb9cf8548b42.en: 거짓말을 하자니 마음이 불편하다 gives the opposing drawback, completing the dilemma.

c1b9fb9cf8548b42.zh: 「거짓말을 해서 좋다」表示說謊很好，不合常理且無法形成左右為難的句意。
c1b9fb9cf8548b42.en: 거짓말을 해서 좋다 means it is good to lie, which makes no sense in this dilemma context.

c1b9fb9cf8548b42.zh: 「친구가 좋아한다」缺少與前句 말하자니 相對應的另一個「-자니」選項。
c1b9fb9cf8548b42.en: 친구가 좋아한다 lacks the parallel -자니 clause needed to express torn feelings.

c1b9fb9cf8548b42.zh: 「말하고 싶다」表示想說，無法與前半句說出實話後的擔憂構成對比。
c1b9fb9cf8548b42.en: 말하고 싶다 simply means wanting to speak, failing to balance the two dilemmas.

c209e50ffa9128a9.en: 사실 ends in a consonant, so it takes 이라손 치더라도 to mean even if it were true.
이다손 is incorrect because nouns take the quoting form 이라손.

c209e50ffa9128a9.zh: 「인손」不是文法上成立的接續形態。
c209e50ffa9128a9.en: 인손 is not a valid grammatical form for this structure.
이라서 indicates a reason (because it is) and cannot precede 치더라도.

c2d3497300cab0d5.zh: 「-기로서니」與「아무리」常搭配，表示「就算…也不能…」的責怪語氣。
c2d3497300cab0d5.en: -기로서니 pairs with 아무리 to express reproach: even if busy, that is no reason not to call.

c2d3497300cab0d5.zh: 「-기만」表示「光是…」，無法與「아무리」及後方的反詰問句相搭配。
c2d3497300cab0d5.en: -기만 means only doing something and does not fit the rhetorical reproach pattern.

c2d3497300cab0d5.zh: 「-기 위해」表示目的「為了…」，放入此句中前後語義矛盾不合。
c2d3497300cab0d5.en: -기 위해 means in order to, which does not fit this reproachful rhetorical question.

c2d3497300cab0d5.zh: 「-기로」常表示決定或規定做某事，無法表達「就算再…」的反詰責備。
c2d3497300cab0d5.en: -기로 typically expresses a resolution or rule, not a concessive reproach.

c317214eaedc7f68.zh: 形容詞「크다」無尾音，正確接續「-ㄹ뿐더러」。
c317214eaedc7f68.en: 크다 is an adjective ending in a vowel, correctly taking -ㄹ뿐더러.

c317214eaedc7f68.zh: 「큰뿐더러」冠形詞形接法錯誤，形容詞應接「-ㄹ뿐더러」。
c317214eaedc7f68.en: 큰뿐더러 incorrectly uses the modifier form -(으)ㄴ instead of -(으)ㄹ.
크는뿐더러 incorrectly adds the verb modifier -는 to an adjective.
크고뿐더러 incorrectly combines the connective ending -고 with 뿐더러.

c4046084bdfbc168.zh: 受詞「책을」接副詞「좀」修飾「읽을라치면」，後接子句主詞「동생이」連接後續動作。
c4046084bdfbc168.en: The object 책을 and adverb 좀 precede 읽을라치면, followed by the subject 동생이 for the next clause.

c4fc7d55559d9941.zh: 前句為「古今中外無一例外」，後接「教育一直被看重」最合語義邏輯。
c4fc7d55559d9941.en: 'Education was always valued' logically follows 'regardless of time and place'.

c4fc7d55559d9941.zh: 「只有東方重視」與「古今中外（東書古今）」的涵蓋範圍矛盾。
c4fc7d55559d9941.en: 'Only the East valued education' contradicts 'across all times and places'.

c4fc7d55559d9941.zh: 「沒有教育」語義突兀且與常理不合。
c4fc7d55559d9941.en: 'There was no education' makes no sense in this context.

c4fc7d55559d9941.zh: 「西方有所不同」語意不完整且違背「無一例外」的含意。
c4fc7d55559d9941.en: 'The West was different' contradicts the non-exceptional nature of 막론하고.

c5d6ce1184c38e87.zh: 「-고도 남다」為慣用句型，表示能力或程度「綽綽有餘」，合於句意。
c5d6ce1184c38e87.en: -고도 남는다 forms the set pattern meaning to have more than enough capability to pass.

c5d6ce1184c38e87.zh: 「려고」表示意圖或目的「為了…」，後接 남는다 語意不通。
c5d6ce1184c38e87.en: 려고 marks intention or purpose, which cannot be combined with 남는다.

c5d6ce1184c38e87.zh: 「다가」表示動作途中中斷或轉變，不能與 남는다 搭配表示游刃有餘。
c5d6ce1184c38e87.en: 다가 signifies an action interrupted by another, not fitting the pattern with 남는다.

c5d6ce1184c38e87.zh: 「느라」表示因某事耗費精力而帶來不良結果，無法與 남는다 連用。
c5d6ce1184c38e87.en: 느라 indicates cause for a negative result and does not collocate with 남는다.

c64f1401622da217.zh: 條件句「처음 보는 사람이라면」後接謂語「놀랄」，構成「놀랄 법해요」。
c64f1401622da217.en: 처음 보는 사람이라면 sets up the condition, leading naturally to 놀랄 before 법해요.

c8a27b864d9dc342.zh: 名詞「돈」有收音，表示「微薄的錢但也想盡一份心」應接「이나마」。
c8a27b864d9dc342.en: 돈 ends in a final consonant, so 이나마 correctly attaches to mean small amount as it is.

c8a27b864d9dc342.zh: 「나마」接在無收音名詞後，「돈」有收音故不能直接接「나마」。
c8a27b864d9dc342.en: 나마 is used after nouns without a final consonant; 돈 has a final consonant.

c8a27b864d9dc342.zh: 「마저」表示「連……也（最後剩下的）」，通常帶有負面或無奈語氣。
c8a27b864d9dc342.en: 마저 means even or including the last remaining one, typically in negative contexts.

c8a27b864d9dc342.zh: 「부터」表示起點「從……開始」，與句意「盡微薄之力」不符。
c8a27b864d9dc342.en: 부터 indicates a starting point meaning from, which does not match the sentence context.

cb8acd018cbc0f5e.zh: 主詞「누가」接「볼세라」表擔心，副詞「얼른」修飾後文受詞與動詞。
cb8acd018cbc0f5e.en: Subject 누가 takes 볼세라 to express fear of being seen; adverb 얼른 modifies hiding the letter 편지를.

cea4cef43b62fa60.zh: 「예약했기에」符合已預約的事實，構成「-기에 망정이지」。
cea4cef43b62fa60.en: 예약했기에 correctly forms the past-tense pattern with -기에 망정이지.

cea4cef43b62fa60.zh: 此處避開險境通常指過去已完成的動作，故用過去式較自然。
cea4cef43b62fa60.en: 예약하기에 uses the present form; past completed actions take -았/었기에 here.
예약했기로 uses the wrong particle -로 instead of -기에.

cea4cef43b62fa60.zh: 「-할세라」表示擔心某事發生而採取行動，用法不符。
cea4cef43b62fa60.en: 예약할세라 expresses fear that something might happen, not fitting this pattern.

cecf1fd8296caa0a.zh: 「-아/어 마지않다」表由衷祝願，「기원해 마지않습니다」為標準表達。
cecf1fd8296caa0a.en: -아/어 마지않습니다 correctly completes the formal expression of sincere well-wishes.

cecf1fd8296caa0a.zh: 「마지못합니다」表示「迫不得已、勉強」，與由衷祈願矛盾。
cecf1fd8296caa0a.en: 마지못합니다 means reluctantly or unwillingly, which does not fit.

cecf1fd8296caa0a.zh: 「마지막입니다」意為「是最後一次」，與句意無關。
cecf1fd8296caa0a.en: 마지막입니다 means it is the last, which does not make sense here.

cecf1fd8296caa0a.zh: 韓語中不存在「마지있다」這個文法形式。
cecf1fd8296caa0a.en: 마지있습니다 is an invalid form; the pattern is strictly negative.

d0664fa9e00276b8.zh: 後續常接「-(으)ㄹ 뻔했다」，表示差點發生不好的事。
d0664fa9e00276b8.en: Sentences with -기에 망정이지 typically end with -(으)ㄹ 뻔했다 to show a bad outcome was avoided.

d0664fa9e00276b8.zh: 「크게 다쳤어요」表示真的受重傷，與「幸好」互相矛盾。
d0664fa9e00276b8.en: 크게 다쳤어요 means you actually got hurt, contradicting 'good thing I wore a seatbelt'.

d0664fa9e00276b8.zh: 「운전을 했어요」意思是「開了車」，與前半句上下文不合。
d0664fa9e00276b8.en: 운전을 했어요 simply means 'I drove', which does not make sense here.

d0664fa9e00276b8.zh: 「차가 막혔어요」意思是「塞車了」，並非繫安全帶避開的險境。
d0664fa9e00276b8.en: 차가 막혔어요 means 'traffic was jammed', not the crisis avoided by wearing a seatbelt.

d2478e13b9cd6203.zh: 「마지않다」修飾後方名詞「선생님」，現在時冠形詞語尾接「-는」。
d2478e13b9cd6203.en: The verb 마지않다 modifies the noun 선생님 using the present modifier -는.

d2478e13b9cd6203.zh: 「-은」用於動詞過去時制，此處表示現在持續尊敬，不適用。
d2478e13b9cd6203.en: -은 marks the past tense for verbs, which is not suitable here.

d2478e13b9cd6203.zh: 「-을」是未來時制冠形詞尾，語意不合。
d2478e13b9cd6203.en: -을 is the prospective/future modifier ending and does not fit.

d2478e13b9cd6203.zh: 「-기」為名詞形語尾，無法修飾名詞「선생님」。
d2478e13b9cd6203.en: -기 turns the verb into a noun and cannot modify 선생님.

d34a35cc7a6bbd42.zh: 「기쁜 나머지」表示過於高興而引發極端反應，接「流下眼淚」最自然。
d34a35cc7a6bbd42.en: 기쁜 나머지 indicates an overwhelming emotional state, naturally leading to shedding tears.

d34a35cc7a6bbd42.zh: 「去考試」是客觀行動，不能作為得知合格消息後因情緒過度產生的反應。
d34a35cc7a6bbd42.en: 시험을 봤다 means took an exam, which makes no sense as a result of hearing passing news.

d34a35cc7a6bbd42.zh: 「開始讀書」與聽到合格消息後高興的情緒反應邏輯不合。
d34a35cc7a6bbd42.en: 공부를 시작했다 means started studying, which does not follow naturally from rejoicing over passing.

d34a35cc7a6bbd42.zh: 「生氣」與前文「高興得…」的情緒完全矛盾。
d34a35cc7a6bbd42.en: 화가 났다 means got angry, directly contradicting the feeling of joy in 기쁜 나머지.

d466cc8e350390e1.zh: 主詞「이번 공연은」在前，慣用語修飾「더할 나위」接修飾語「없는」。
d466cc8e350390e1.en: The subject 이번 공연은 leads into the fixed idiom 더할 나위 modifying the following 없는.

d4efe5e5f96bf9d4.zh: 主詞「그가」接受詞「그 비밀을」，再接動詞定語「알」修飾「턱이 없어요」。
d4efe5e5f96bf9d4.en: Subject 그가 leads to object 그 비밀을, followed by modifier 알 before 턱이 없어요.

d56d697891e9e433.zh: 「깰세라」表示擔心孩子醒來而小心翼翼，符合文意。
d56d697891e9e433.en: 깰세라 correctly expresses acting quietly for fear that the baby might wake up.

d56d697891e9e433.zh: 韓語中沒有「깨는세라」這種文法形態。
d56d697891e9e433.en: The form 깨는세라 does not exist in Korean grammar.

d56d697891e9e433.zh: 「깨서」表示「因為醒來」，與後文小心行走的語境矛盾。
d56d697891e9e433.en: 깨서 means because the baby woke up, contradicting walking quietly.

d56d697891e9e433.zh: 「깨도록」表示「為了讓其醒來」或到醒來的程度，語意不合。
d56d697891e9e433.en: 깨도록 means so that the baby wakes up, which does not fit.

d69313ace902929c.zh: 「-(으)ㄴ/는 듯이」表示「彷彿、好像」，後接動詞「말했다」。
d69313ace902929c.en: 듯이 attaches to 아는 to form as if he knew, modifying 말했다.

d69313ace902929c.zh: 「척」通常搭配「-(으)ㄴ/는 척하다」，沒有「척이 말했다」的用法。
d69313ace902929c.en: 척 usually combines with 하다 as -는 척하다, not 척이 말했다.

d69313ace902929c.zh: 「-는 바람에」表示消極原因或理由，不能與「아는」後接「말했다」搭配。
d69313ace902929c.en: 바람에 expresses a negative cause and cannot follow 아는 to mean as if.
척을 typically pairs with 하다 (척을 하다), not with 말했다 directly.

d88da046599373ae.zh: 形容詞定語「작은」修飾「선물이나마」，接著由副詞賓語「마음을」接副詞形「담아」。
d88da046599373ae.en: The modifier 작은 qualifies 선물이나마, which is followed by the object 마음을 and the verb 담아.

d8c9f544a6d2bddf.zh: 符合-(으)ㄹ뿐더러追加同方向負面情況的用法。
d8c9f544a6d2bddf.en: Correctly adds another negative aspect to matching the tone of being difficult.
아주 쉽다 means very easy, contradicting the negative first clause.

d8c9f544a6d2bddf.zh: 「금방 끝난다」是正向情況，與前句的辛苦語氣矛盾。
d8c9f544a6d2bddf.en: 금방 끝난다 means it ends quickly, which clashes with the hardship expressed.
재미있다 means interesting or fun, which contradicts the negative evaluation.

d937c638810123cc.zh: 「더할 나위 없다」為固定慣用語，動詞「더하다」後接「-(으)ㄹ」。
d937c638810123cc.en: 더할 나위 없다 is a fixed idiom requiring future/prospective -(으)ㄹ on 더하다.

d937c638810123cc.zh: 「하는」是現在式定語字尾，不能用於此固定慣用句型中。
